sanskrit: uttamā sarvatantrāṇāṃ bālāyāḥ pūjanasṛtiḥnāśiṣyāya pradātavyamaśuddhāya śaṭhāya cabhaktihīnāya maline gurunindāparāya cadeyaṃ bhaktavare mukteḥ kāraṇaṃ bhaktivardhanamsaiva kalpalatā tasya vāñchāphalakarī tathāakṣubdhaḥ san paṭhedyastu śatayajñasya puṇyabhāksvayaṃ śivaḥ sa vijñeyo yo bālābhāvalampaṭaḥānando yo'pi yaṃ vedā vadantyasyā vaśe sthitāḥsadānandābhyāsayogāt sadānandaḥ prajāyateśrībālātripurasundarīsahasranāmakampañcamāṅgaṃ rahasyaṃ me śrutvā gopyaṃ prayatnataḥpatnīprabhayārditasya] tasyarambhāpi jṛmbhārisabhāṃ vihāya bhūmau bhajet taṃ kuladīkṣitaṃ cavidhāya līlāṃ bhuvane tathānte nirāmayaṃ brahmapadaṃ prayātibindupīṭhe'rcayedbālāṃ yo'sau prānte śivo bhavetsa bhaved bhuvi sārvabhaumamaulistridive śakrasamānaśauryalakṣmīḥadātavyamabhaktebhyo gopanīyaṃ svayonivatsaṃsthitau pārvatīśambhū lokarakṣaṇatatparaudevadeva suraśreṣṭha dayātraiguṇyamānasaasmiṃścarācare vyakte krūre kena prakāśitārevātaṭe mahāpuṇye śrīgarbhā nāma satpurītasyāṃ babhūva viprendradevagandharvasevitamtasmiṃstapovane puṇye sevite'pi sureśvaraiḥnānāśāstrābdhipoto'pi sarvāgamanidhirabhūtprākpuṇyakarmaṇā tasmai tuṣṭā tripurasundarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlaṃ ca [g: svaśūlaṃ] śikṣito devyāḥ śuddhamamṛtarūpaṇamtadā prabhṛti tanmantraṃ dhyāyan stotraṃ japan hṛditadanugrahamātreṇa sa munīśvarapūjitaḥanyān nānāvidhān granthān prekṣya trailokyapūjitegranthamuddhārakośākhyaṃ sarvāgamaviniścitamśrotumuddhārakośākhyaṃ nānāgamaviniścitamdevīnāṃ daśavidyānāṃ mantroddhāramanuttamamsarvagranthādyapūjyaṃ ca tacchṛṇuṣva bravīmyahamabravīd dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ śiṣyamakṣobhyanāmakam [kh: chātraṃ]rahasyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ devānāmapi durlabhammunīndro dakṣiṇāmūrtirabravīd granthamuttamamdevānāṃ devatānāṃ ca tacchṛṇuṣva bravīmyahampūrṇaḥśaktiḥ praṇavalajje tu lakṣmīḥ śaktyādikaṃ tataḥ(trikūṭā sakalā bhadre vidyeyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarī)śarat tryakṣaṃ tathā kṣāmā lakṣmīḥ śaktyādikaṃ tathā [kh: tataḥ]lakṣmībījāni saptaiva kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi tuśriyo bījāni pañcaivamanṛtānyaparāṇi tusamastāpi tathā kṣāmā devīpraṇavavīrakauśivabījaṃ maheśāni lajjābījamudāhṛtammāraḥ pradyumnakandarpāvanṛtānyaparāṇi tucandro'pi carmavasanaṃ [kh: caṇḍo'pi varma] vāsanāpi tathaiva caśaktibījāni catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi tutrāsastāraka etāni bījāni praṇavasya caviparītatayā proktā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātaṅgī śārikā rājñī bhīḍā jvālāmukhī tathāetā daśaiva ṣaḍanyā yojitā ṣoḍaśākṣarīdakṣiṇākālikā śyāmā kālarātryapi sundaribrahmādidevataiḥ pūjyā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarīviparītatayā proktaṃ satvaraṃ phaladāyakamjalabījāni proktāni hyasatyāni parāṇi tutārtīyaṃ ca jagatpārśvo vahnibījasamujjvalaḥbījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyamante proktaṃ nama itiṅentā natyantiko mantraḥ prokta ekādaśākṣaraḥanyāni kṛtrimāṇyeva surāsuranamaskṛtekūrcaṃ caiva maheśāni hyante phaṭ ṭhadvayaṃ tathāhāṃ bījoddhārametaddhi cānyadanṛtamāvadetlambhāpi lalanā lajjā hyasatyanyaparāṇi tuante viśvaṃ nāma madhye proktaṃ vai tu [kh: tubhyaṃ] sureśvaribījānyetāni mantrasya kṛtrimānyaparāṇi tucārukaṃ rasabījāni hyādau proktāni śambhunāvāsanā paṅkajaṃ caiva vanaṃ proktaṃ ca śūlinākrīṃ bījāni ca hyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caprīṃ bījāni tu proktāni hyasatyānyaparāṇi tucatuṣṭayaṃ ca cchrīṃ bīje asatyānyaparāṇi capañca ṭhakārabījāni hyasatyānyaparāṇi cakalyāṇaṃ śārikādevyā bījaṃ saptākṣaraṃ smṛtamphrāṃbījāni ca [kh: hi] catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cahakāraṃ cāpi vijñeyamuktaṃ tadrudrayāmale [kh: ca]aparamanṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvaranandini
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārāyaṇajapenāsti yādṛśī mantriṇāṃ śivepārāyaṇajapaṃ brūhi yadyahaṃ tava vallabhāyena siddhiyuto mantrī bhavedbhairavasannibhaḥteṣāṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ vakṣye yena brahmamayo bhavettasyaiva saguṇasyātra cintanaṃ ghaṭikājapaḥsiddhaḥ sādhya iti smṛtvā japet pārāyaṇaṃ manumtadādi nityaṃ ghaṭikaikamānāt pratyakṣaraṃ yāti dine dine'rkaḥtribhāgamādyantarayostathānte vidhāya mantrasya japenmumukṣuḥghaṭīpramāṇāḥ kulamātṛkāyā bhavanti varṇā manurājasiddhyaiḥmūlavidyāṃ japenmantrī śivaśaktimayīṃ śivepañcaṣaṣṭyakṣarīmūlān pañcanādātmako bhavetvidyānte'pi tyajedvidyāṃ śivarūpāṃ śivo bhavettadā prabhṛti loke'smin mātṛkāsu caredraviḥlakṣmīṃ prāpya śivo mantrī saubhāgyāntāṃ yathākramamhaṃsāntāṃ sañjaped devi mantrī mātṛkayā sadāmahāśrīṣoḍaśīvidyāmaṣṭabhūtimayīṃ parāmbrahmavidyālayotthānaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥpaṭalaḥyaṃ vijñāya bhaved devi sarvasaukhyamayaḥ sudhīḥbālātripurasundaryāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥsādhyastripurabhairavyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥmahātripurasundaryā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥsarvadoṣavinirmuktā purāpi kathitaṃ mayābhadrakālyā ayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti sundari [ṅ: pārvati]rājamātaṅginīdevyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bījaṃ ca ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharetebhiḥ saha manuḥ prokto rājñyāḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥraṃ bījoddhārametaddhi kṛtrimamaparaṃ smṛtamviyacchaktyagnibījāni saṃyojya vāgbhavaṃ tathāṭhadvayena samāyuktaḥ prokto viṃśākṣaro manuḥbījaṃ ca tryakṣaraṃ [kh: ṣaḍakṣaraṃ devyā jvālāmukhyāḥ sureśvarisādhakeṣṭapradā devyo nānāratnavibhūṣitāḥvidyāṃ dadāti vāgdevī pratyekaṃ janmaniścalāmmātaṅgī rākṣasīśatrubhītiṃ harati nityaśaḥbhīḍādevī dadātyeva santatiṃ viśvavyāpinīmprayacchanti mahādevyaḥ pūjāhomajapādibhiḥdaśavidyāmantroddhārakośākhyānaṃ prathamaḥ kalpaḥṣaṭsakhībhirahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi teśrotumicchāmyahaṃ mantrān sarvān saṃmuktihetavedaśavidyā bhadrakālī turī ca cchinnamastakāṣaṭsakhīnāmahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi tebhadrakālipadaṃ brūyād bījāni pratilomataḥanṛtamaparaṃ jñeyaṃ brahmānvayasamudbhavaante ucchūnabījaṃ phaṭ ṭhadvayena samāyutamvajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭsvāhayā yutedakṣiṇe kāliketyevamante kālītrayaṃ punaḥdakṣiṇāyāḥ kālikāyā manurdvāviṃśadakṣaraḥtataḥ sudhārase śyāme kṛṣṇaśāpaṃ vimocayabījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharetnīro [kh: vīryaṃ] dehi yugaṃ madhye tyaktvābhidhāṃ ca kāmini
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deveśi tripurābālaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvādaśātmakamkevalaṃ muktaye devi yatproktaṃ tacchubhaṃ smṛtamparaṃ yat sūcitaṃ devi sadyo muktipradaṃ smṛtamaṣṭabhirvatsarairvāpi māsairaṣṭabhireva calakṣmībhedadvayaṃ jñeyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ kṛttivāsasābhedāstvete tu [g: ca] vikhyātāḥ phalaṃ varṣacatuṣṭayenīlasarasvatī caivamugratārā prakīrtitābhaktyā phalapradā devī nityaṃ varṣacatuṣṭayemātaṅgī [g: taṅga] cakriṇī devī kubjikā śāmbarī tathādvivarṣamadhye bhaktyā ca rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchatiyatheṣṭaphaladaṃ proktaṃ jvālābhedatrayamidamcāmuṇḍā nārasiṃhī ca hyaindrī haimavatīśvarīdevyā dvādaśabhedāstu proktā hyete triśūlināhrīṃ ca madanaḥ kāmaṃ parā rukmiṇīvidyāśrīrviparītabhāvasahitā syāt ṣoḍaśātmāvidhiḥbhedairyutānāṃ devīnāṃ mantraṃ [g: manuṃ] tvaṃ vaktumarhasitryakṣaṃ hrīṃ śaktinīramante proktamathāpi dhūrjaṭināante proktaṃ maheśāni lakṣmībhedaṃ dvayaṃ tvidamnamo'nte parameśāni mayā proktaṃ nagātmajetryakṣaṃ viśvaṃ tathānte ca parvateśvaranandinietāsāṃ daśavidyānāmanyāsāṃ śṛṇu vacmyahamturī bhedavihīnāsti yatheṣṭaphaladāyinīetā bhedavihīnāśca yathākāmaphalapradāḥṣaḍdevīmantroddhārakośabhedasūcako dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥśṛṇuṣvaikāgramanasā bravīmi tvatkutūhalāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāṣitā ṣoḍaśīvidyā nanandākṣobhyako muniḥāyayurmunayaḥ sarve sotsukā mantrakāṅkṣiṇaḥśāṇḍilyagālavau caivamete tasyāśramaṃ yayuḥparasparaṃ vai svakuleṣṭadevīmantrāṃśca vandyān śubhadān papracchuḥcarācare'smiñjagati devī tripurasundarītasyāśca vadanāmbhojāt sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayāacireṇaiva kālena phaladāstanmukhācśrutāḥprasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe cedasmāsu dayā tavayena śravaṇamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhetsapta vidyāḥ purā proktā vajrayoginyādidevatāḥdakṣiṇāmūrtinā teṣāṃ prakāśitāni tattvataḥkāmeśvarī tathā gaurī hyannapūrṇā tathaiva cadakṣiṇāmūrtinā teṣāṃ sapta vidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥsasṛje jagadetacca pālyate ca sureśvaritāsāṃ vakṣyāmi mantrāṇi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥmadhye'pi vajrayoginyai hyante nīramudāhṛtamsa nirjitya ripūn sarvān kalyāṇī gṛhamāviśetdvādaśadivasaṃ tāvatsiddhirbhavati vāñchitāṛtusnātāyā bhāryāyā maithunaṃ kurute naraḥlikhitvā sa bhavedrājā asyā yantraṃ samantrakamasyāḥ saṃbhogakāle tu mantraṃ japet sureśvariasyā yantraṃ samantraṃ ca bāhau yo dhārayennaraḥasyā yantraṃ samantraṃ ca hṛdi yo dhārayennaraḥasyā yantraṃ samantraṃ ca kukṣau yo dhārayennaraḥtasyāstripurasundaryā mukhāmbhojānmayā śrutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāgbhavaṃ sauśmakaṃ caiva tataḥ pallavamuddharetvarāhamukhi caivaṃ tu vāsanā ca maṭhaṃ tathābhagavatyāstu vārāhyā ekatriṃśākṣaro manuḥglauṃ bījoddhāramedaddhi cānyadanṛtamāvadetlaṃ bījoddhārāṇyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi tumantraṃ ca ṣ't śiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharetmadanamūrmidhvāntau dvau saṃyojya stanabījakamjṛmbhaṇākhye [g: jambaḥ] tato devi kāmeśvari tathaiva cakāmeśvaryā mahādevyā dvāviṃśadakṣaro manuḥtārādhipaḥ sudhāraśmiḥ kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cablūṃ bījoddhāranāmāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cajaṃ bījanāmānyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caśivabījaṃ tathā devi gauri śarvaśca ṭhadvayamgaṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caviśvaṃ tato bhagavati māheśvari tataḥ punaḥbījaṃ tu ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ viśvena saha bhāminitaṭaṃ tathecchābījaṃ ca tataḥ pallavamuddharetante ca vāsanābījaṃ padmaṃ kāṅkṣāpi nīrajamkulavāgīśvarīdevyāsturyaviṃśākṣaro manuḥjhaṃ bījasyaiva nāmāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi capaṇyastrī pañca nāmāni phrīṃ bījasyānṛtaṃ paramadyāhaṃ tava bhaktyā te hṛdi yadrocate priyamkṛpayāpi purā mahyaṃ sūcitā na prakāśitāḥmanūn pañcakumārāṇāmasmākaṃ vaktumarhasidakṣiṇāmūrtinoktaṃ yat tatte vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hanumadbhairavāvete bhāṣitāḥ pañca bālakāḥkārtavīryājunaścaiva hanumadbhairavau tathākārtavīryārjuno'pyevaṃ sugrīvo hanumāṃstathāśaṅkaraṃ ṣaṭśiromantraṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharetsarvajanaṃ tataḥ paścānme vaśamānayeti camadhye kumārāya namo hyante nīramudāhṛtamhrāṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caśukrabījaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ kamalā rasanā tathāmadhye tannāma vijñeyaṃ kārtavīryārjunāya cadaityamānyo [kh: daityāmātyo] maheśāni surāsuranamaskṛtehanumate tataḥ paścādrāmadūtāya vai punaḥbhūtāya śākinī caiva ḍākinī tadanantaramvibhīṣaṇāya hanumaddevāya tadanantaramharamāpastathānte'pi saptaṣaṣṭyakṣaro manuḥabdhibījaṃ kalpabījaṃ śataghnībījasaṃyutamante'po bhairavasyāyaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥvīṃ bījāni ca pañcaivamanṛtāni parāṇi caruṃ bījāni ca catvāri (kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca)kṣāmikaṃ kṣurakaṃ kṣaudraṃ tathā kalpāntabījakamghnīṃ bījāni tu pañcaivamasatyānyaparāṇi catasmācchaktiḥ khaṃ śarad hṛjjatārau mantroddhāro devi mṛtyuñjayasyakālīpadmau kūrcapadmau samastāpadmau nīrameṣa sugrīvamantraḥbravīmi bhavatāṃ prītyā ājñāpayitumarhathasaptakumārakośākhyānaṃ tṛtīyaḥ kalpaḥnavagrahāṇāṃ mantrāṃśca tān vakṣyāmi samāsataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ete pañca maheśāni pañceṣorbāṇadevatāḥdevasya khaṇḍaparaśorlocanatrayadevatāḥete nava grahāḥ proktāḥ śambhunā rudrayāmalebījaṃ turyaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharetante payastu vijñeyaṃ manurdvyaṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥharitaṃ hariṇībījaṃ haridrābījameva camadhye'pi grahanāthāya budhāyānte ca ṭhadvayamśāmbhavaḥ śālinībījaṃ tathā ṣaṇmukhabījakamśivabījaṃ tato madhye graheśvarāya vai punaḥtaraṅgaveśye saṃyojya cārvaṅgī hiṅgubījakamtato grahādhipataye bṛhaspataya eva cavāsanā paṅkajaṃ caivamante proktaṃ vanaṃ śivecandro maṭhaṃ tataḥ paścād grahādhipataye namaḥharetiśabdaṃ saṃyojya śūnyānusvārasaṃyutamcaṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cavedhobījaṃ tato madhye grahādhipataye tataḥkaṃ- bījānyapi catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cagrahacakravartine'pi śanaiścarāya vai tataḥśanaiścarasya devasya manurviṃśākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥtataṣṭaṅkadhāriṇe ca rāhave havyavāhanaḥrāhorviṃśākṣaro bālo yathābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥṭaṃ- bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi casudine sādhako mantrān grahāṇāṃ sādhayecchiveketave'pi tataḥ paścāccandraḥ śaṅkā payastathākrūṃ- bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athāhaṃ tava deveśi varṇānāṃ vacmi vai manūnyena vijñānamātreṇa māntrikaḥ sādhako bhavetnavagrahamantroddhārakośākhyānaṃ caturthaḥ kalpaḥprasanno'si mahābhāginnasmāsu kṛpayā prabhovarṇānāṃ śrotumicchāmo mantrakośāni ca vayamvarṇānāṃ mantrakośaṃ ca niḥsṛtaṃ tripurāmukhātmunīnāṃ sūcitaṃ yacca dakṣiṇāmūrtinā purāmānasaṃ ca manobījaṃ paitāmahamiti smṛtamśūnyaṃ khamambaraṃ vyoma vaiṣṇavaṃ ceti bhāṣitamindrabījaṃ tathā jiṣṇurmarutvān maghamā hariḥmayā proktaṃ sureśāni granthe bhairavatantrakeaindraṃ tathaiva vijñeyamīkārasyānṛtaṃ paramrutibījaṃ tathā nandā vāmanaṃ vītubījakam [g: vātu]mayākhyātāni sarvasve kubjikāyāḥ sureśvariaindavamanṛtamanyadūkārasya sureśvariṛkārasya rahasye'smin kālyāḥ proktaṃ mayā śiveṝkārasyānṛtamanyad bhāṣitaṃ viṣṇuyāmalevyaktabījaṃ jagadbījaṃ gaurvaṃ proktaṃ mayā śivegaṅgābījaṃ surnadī ca nākavāpī ca svardhunīgranthe ca svakṛtau devi mantrasāgaratantrakevallībījaṃ ca vārākī cānyadanṛtamāvadetkulacūḍāmaṇau granthe racite māntrikottamaiḥcaṇḍo'pi [kh: candro'pi] carma vasanaṃ vāsanā ca tathaiva carāhu khyātaṃ mayā devi aikārasyānṛtaṃ parampraṇavaṃ ca tatastāraṃ [g: dhanustā] tryakṣaṃ tomāpi tryambakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chinnāśiromaṇau granthe racite vai mayā svayamāgastyaṃ ca mayā khyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrakebhūruhaṃ ca mayākhyātamanṛtamaparaṃ vadetnāgabījaṃ bhūdharaṃ ca bhhargyabījaṃ ca bhānavamgranthe tripurasundaryāḥ sarvasve viśvadurlabhe [g: vallabhe]vedhobījaṃ vidhirbrahmā svayambhūbījameva cagranthe chinnārahasye'smin parvateśvaranandinivaiṣṭaraśravabījaṃ ca proktaṃ tripurayā svayamśivabījaṃ ca śambhuśca śarvaḥ śaṅkara eva cakulacūḍāmaṇau granthe durlabhe tridive priyemāyātmajo'rkabandhuśca gautamamanṛtaṃ paramṣaḍānanaḥ śarajanmā skandaḥ kumārabījakamkubjikāsarvasve khyātaṃ mayā trailokyapūjitecakārasya mayā khyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrakekālaṃ ca saurabījaṃ ca sūtiḥ sundarabījakamstanabījaṃ kucaṃ caivamurojo hṛjjameva caāgamālaṅkāraje ca granthe bhairavanirmitejhakārasya mayā khyātamasatyamaparaṃ smṛtamyamabījaṃ kālabījaṃ kṛtāntasamavartinautripurāsarvasve granthe trijagaddurlabhe priyeṭakārasya mayā khyātaṃ svatantre devavanditepañca ṭhakārabījāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi casiṃhikā sarasībījaṃ reṇukābījameva caḍakārasya mayā devi granthe vai rudrayāmalesamīraṃ cāśugaṃ jñeyaṃ vātaṃ śvasanabījakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāṇabījaṃ mārgaṇaṃ ca patriṇamāśugaṃ tathārātribījaṃ tamībījaṃ tāmasībījameva [g: tāmasī ca niśā mamā] cakubjikāsarvasve granthe taṃbījaṃ ca mayā smṛtamthakārasya mayā khyātaṃ tantre vai kulikārṇave [g: kubjikā]bhogibījaṃ bhujaṅgaṃ ca bhujaṅgamamiti smṛtamsvatantre devadeveśi dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛtedhakārasyānṛtamanyat tripurātilake smṛtamvārāhamanṛtamanyanmayā khyātaṃ sureśvarikūrmamīnapadavyāptau bījārṇaṃ sadṛśaṃ priyebhāṣaṇoddhāraviṣaye likhane prakṛtiḥ pṛthakjhaṣabījaṃ mayākhyātaṃ granthe chinnāśiromaṇaukacchapamanṛtamanyanmayākhyātaṃ ca bhāminiūrmirvīcistathā caivaṃ taraṅgastritayaṃ smṛtamkālikākulasarvasve brahmaṇaiva prakāśitetantre vai muṇḍamālāyāṃ mayākhyātaṃ sureśvaribhekībījaṃ mayākhyātamasatyamaparaṃ smṛtamvāyubījaṃ tathā vāgmi vācālaṃ vaśyabījakamagnī rephaśca vahniśca hutabhug havyavāhanaḥtamobījaṃ tathā dhvāntaṃ mohaṃ timirameva cabhūbījaṃ dharaṇībījaṃ lakāraṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayāvakārasya mayākhyātaṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvareśakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrakehrādinībījakaṃ caivamasatyamaparaṃ smṛtamśaktiḥ śarmāpi vijñeye śaracchaṅke tathaiva cachavibījaṃ kāntibījaṃ śobhā bhā suṣamā tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhasārasvate granthe nityaṃ māntrikapūjitesurabījaṃ ca gīrbāṇaṃ lekhamamarabījakamnānāmantrayutaṃ devi sarvāgamaviniścitamsarvavarṇakośākhyānaṃ pañcamaḥ kalpaḥpṛthaṅnāma sureśāni sakalāgamaniścitamdakṣiṇāmūrtinā pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāṣitāḥ svayamindrākṣī sā tṛtīyā ca tisro bhuvanadevatāḥyasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ varānanehariṇākṣī dvayaṃ kūrcaṃ haraṃ ṭhadvayasaṃyutammantraṃ ca dvi śiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharettato'pi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ tathāvināśaya dvivāraṃ ca mṛttikābījakaṃ tathāmṛtsā'nṛtaṃ paraṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvaranandiniprasthabījaṃ parāṃ padmāṃ carmāṇaṃ ca tato'bhidhāmtīrayugmaṃ rasane dve trāsaścandro haraṃ vanammlauṃ bījoddhārametaddhi cānyadanṛtamāvadetdakṣiṇāmūrtinā bhaktyā saṃsāre'smin prakāśitāḥyāmāśritya labhedyogī khecarīṃ siddhidāṃ kalāmtamobījaṃ tato dadyānmāyābījaṃ tataḥ parammantraṃ (bījaṃ) turyaśiro jñeyaṃ yogī dadyāttato'bhidhāmkhecaryāśca kośākhyānaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥetāsāṃ devatānāṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu pārvati tattvataḥvāmakeśvara tantroktaṃ tripurāyāḥ sureśvaritripurāṃ bhaje'hammunisādhakagīrvāṇa vighnavargaiḥ [kh: vipravargaiḥ] supūjitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantro'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ saṃpuṭākhyaḥ susiddhidaḥugratārāmanoreṣa mantraḥ śrīsaṃpuṭābhidhaḥmantro'yaṃ chinnamastāyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'tidurlabhaḥdevyā ucchiṣṭamātaṅgyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥsarasvatyā manordevi mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥannapūrṇāmanoreṣa manuḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥdevatāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥśārikāmūlamantrasya mantraḥ saṃpuṭakābhidhaḥśāradāyāḥ sarasvatyā'mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥindrākṣyā vajrahastāyā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥśrīdevyā bagalāmukhyā mantraḥ saṃpuṭakābhidhaḥmahāturyā manoreṣa saṃpuṭākhyo'sti siddhidaḥmahārājñyā manoreṣa manuḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥjvālāmukhyā ayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti pārvatisaṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ mantro bhīḍāyā devadurlabhaḥkālarātrimanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakāraṇambhavānīmūlamantrasya saṃpuṭo'yaṃ mayeritaḥsaṃpuṭo varṇito devi śrīvajrayoginīmanoḥmantro'yaṃ dhūmravārāhyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo mayeritaḥsiddhalakṣmīmanoreṣa saṃpuṭo varṇito mayāmantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti kulavāgīśvarīmanoḥpadmāvatīmanoreṣa mantraḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥkubjikāmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥgaurīmantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭo varṇito mayākhecarīmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naumyahaṃ bhaktipūrvamtantramuktāvalau granthe durlabhe tridive'pi cadivyairābharaṇairvibhūṣitatanuṃ siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ bhajedevyā bhedavihīnāyā munisādhakapūjitelokatrayaikarakṣaṇaparāṃ tārāṃ trinetrāṃ bhajesādhakeṣṭaprade granthe niḥsṛtaṃ rudrayāmalestotrādyairbhuvaneśvarīṃ trinayanāṃ hṛtpaṅkaje'haṃ bhajekubjikāsarvasve granthe mamāpyatyantadurlabhesadā bhagavatīṃ mātaṅginīṃ hāriṇīmāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ niḥsṛtaṃ durlabhaṃ janaiḥvāmakeśvaratantroktaṃ parvateśvaranandiniśaṅkhābjaśūlāsidharāṃ maheśīṃ rājñīṃ bhaje'haṃ tuhinādrirūpāmniḥsṛtamāgamoddyote mayā viracite svayambhavānīṃ prahasitavadanāṃ sādhakeṣṭapradātrīmdhyānaṃ mayā viracite granthe jvālāśiromaṇausiṃhāsanasthāpitapādayugmāṃ jvālāmukhīṃ saddhṛdaye smarāmisvayaṃ mayā viracite tantre vai vāmakeśvarebhadrakālīṃ navajaladanibhāṃ pretamadhyāsanasthāmasmiṃścarācare khyāte brahmaṇaiva prakāśitebrahmopendramaheśvaraiśca namitāṃ devīṃ bhaje'haṃ turīmsvakṛte tripurāyāśca granthe devi śiromaṇauchinnamastakāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāye hṛdabje sadāgranthe kālīrahasye'smin parvateśvaranandinidakṣiṇakālikāṃ bhagavatīṃ raktāmbarāṃ tāṃ smareśyāmātantre mayākhyātaṃ sakalāgamasāgare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śavaśarīrakṛtāsanasthāmmayā viracite devi tantre vai vāmakeśvaresiṃhāsanasthāṃ dhṛtapītavastrāṃ dhyāye maheśīṃ hṛdi kālarātrīmśrīvajrayoginīdhyānaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ kulikārṇaveabhayaṅkarīm]yathābhīṣṭapradaṃ devi kulacūḍāmaṇau priyevimalāṃ varāhīmśāradāpaṭale granthe racite'pi mayā svayamparvatasthitavatīṃ dhṛtaśūlāṃ śāradāṃ bhagavatīṃ hṛdi dhyāyekāmeśvaryāstripurāyāḥ sarvasve tantrakottamepītāmbarāṃ viṣṇumaheśasevyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tāṃ hṛdaye smarāmigranthe mayā viracite parvateśvaranandinimānasapaṅkaje bhagavatīṃ bhakteṣṭadāṃ tāṃ bhajeniḥsṛtaṃ bhairavītantre mayā devi prakāśiteeṇāsanasthāṃ bhujagopavītāṃ tāmannapūrṇāṃ hṛdaye smarāmiāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ durlabhāyāṃ mamāpi catryakṣāṃ siṃhāsanagatāṃ kulavāgīśvarīṃ bhajeāgamāmṛtapīyūṣe [ g: rṇava] durlabhe bhuvane'mbikedvimṛgādhipagāminaṃ trinetraṃ śivaputraṃ dviradānanaṃ bhaje'hamniḥsṛtamāgamoddyote mayā viracite svayamnagendrakanyāpriyaputramādyaṃ hṛdi smare'bhīṣṭapradaṃ kumāramyathābhīṣṭapradaṃ nṝṇāmuḍḍāmaraviniścitamkārtavīryārjunammṛtyuñjayasya devasya granthe kubjāśiromaṇautaṃ smare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe nirmite mantrasāgarebhajamānamarkatanayaṃ sugrīvadevaṃ hṛdikulacūḍāmaṇau granthe parvateśvaranandinisumeruśṛṅgābhamacintyamādyaṃ hṛdi smare'haṃ hanumantamīḍyamniḥsṛtaṃ bhairave tantre yathābhīṣṭaphalapradamacintyamādyaṃ madhupānasaktaṃ hṛdi smare bhairavamiṣṭadaṃ tamtripurāsarvasve granthe dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛtesaptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastamādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabjeyathābhīṣṭapradaṃ satyaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtedayānidhiṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ budhaṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'hamkubjikāsarvasve granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśitepaṅkaje'hamdhyānaṃ bhairavatantroktaṃ sakalārthapradaṃ nṛṇāmmānasapaṅkaje'hamniḥsṛtamāgamoddyote nānādhyānasaritpataugraheśamāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priyesurāsuraiḥ pūjitapādapadmaṃ bhaumaṃ dayāluṃ hṛdaye smarāminiḥsṛtaṃ ca maheśāni śubhadamāgamāmṛtesurāsurāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ dvibāhuṃ śaniṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'hamniḥsṛtaṃ phaladaṃ nṝṇāṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvaresmarāminiḥsṛtamāgamoddyote granthe vai tantrasāgare [kh: mantra]kṛṣṇāmbaraṃ śaktitriśūlahastaṃ ketuṃ bhaje mānasapaṅkaje'hamkulacūḍāmaṇau granthe niḥsṛtaṃ bhuvaneśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ surāsuranamaskṛtebhakteṣṭadāṃ muktidāmniḥsṛtaṃ jagadīśāni granthe vai rudrayāmalejanamātaraṃ hṛdi bhaje kāruṇyarūpāṃ parāmgranthe bhairavatantrākhye niḥsṛtaṃ tridaśārcitebhuvanamātaraṃ siddhidāmyasya kasya na dātavyaṃ granthamuddhārakośakamjaya tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ gantumājñāpayitumarhasiityuktvā munayo jagmuḥ svagṛhaṃ mantralālasāḥkṛtamuddhārakośākhyaṃ granthaṃ gopyatamaṃ kuruubhau tāvambikā devī devaśca candraśekharaḥkalpaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manornīlasarasvatyāḥ saṃpuṭo varṇito mayāparāśaktimanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakāraṇamsarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye saṃpuṭaṃ surapūjitesarveṣāṃ śaivamantrāṇāṃ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥmṛtyuñjayamanoreṣa saṃpuṭo varṇito mayāamṛteśvaramantrasya saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥsaṃpuṭākhyo manuḥ prokto vaṭukasya mayā śivemantro'yaṃ nīlakaṇṭhasya saṃpuṭākhyo mayeritaḥsadyojātasya mantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥmahāgaṇapatereṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥmantro'styaghoradevasya varṇitaḥ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥśrīkāmeśvaramantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥniṣkīlito mahākālamantro doṣavivarjitaḥvakṣye saṃpuṭamantrāṃśca sādhakānāṃ hitecchayālakṣmīnārāyaṇamanormantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥśrīrādhākṛṣṇamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥsaṃpuṭābhidhaḥlakṣmīnṛsiṃhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥlakṣmīvarāhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥjāmadagnyamanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥśrīsītārāmamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥśrījanārdanamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥviśvaksenamanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥśrīvāsudevamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥtava snehena nirṇītaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yena sādhitamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavetpuraścaraṇahīno hi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācanaardharātre'pi madhyāhne puraścaraṇamārabhetsvaguruṃ pūjayitvādau puraścaryāṃ samārabhetcatuṣkoṇāmīśadiśi svahastaparivistṛtāmlikhed bindutryasramādau ṣaḍaśraṃ vṛttamaṇḍalampuraścaryāyantrametadgaditaṃ girije mayāindrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥpūjyā sahetayo devi dharābhavanamaṇḍalevārāhī caṇḍikā devi pūjanīyāparājitāpārvatī kubjikā durgā cāmuṇḍā nīlatāriṇīgaṅgā ca yamunā devi pūjyā tryaśre sarasvatīmūlamantreṇa gandhārghyapuṣpadhūpādidīpakaiḥvedīvidikṣu saṃsthāpya mantrī ghaṭacatuṣṭayamvahninirṛtivāteśakrameṇaivaṃ samarcayetsvasvamūlena deveśi tatra pūjāṃ tathāhnikīmśrīcakraṃ pūjayitvādau tataḥ kuryājjapaṃ sudhīḥbrahmacaryadharo mantrī dhyāyan devīṃ varapradāmhaviṣyāśī mahādevi tataḥ siddhamanurbhavettarpayet taddaśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyateānīya pūjayenmantrī yathoktavidhinā śiveśaktivakṣaḥsamāśliṣṭo japenmūlaṃ yathāvidhimantrasiddhirbhavet tasya devānāmapi durlabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: putrajanmotsavadine sūtikākulamandirebhavenmanuḥmṛtakāśaucadivase prathame sādhako japetekādaśe'hani sudhīḥ kuryānmantraṃ tu saṃskṛtamathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyatetāvajjaptvā nirātaṅko mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavetsūryoparāgavelāyāṃ japenmantraṃ maheśvariathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyatedaśāṃśasaṃskṛto mantro bhaveccintāmaṇiḥ kṣaṇātvarṇalakṣapuraścaryāphalamāpnoti sādhakaḥavācyaṃ guhyamīśāni gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥpaṭalaḥyaṃ labdhvā sādhako devi martyo'pyamaratāṃ labhetpuraścaraṇahomasya vada me'dya vidhiṃ vibhogatvā rahaḥsthalaṃ devi homaṃ kuryād daśāṃśataḥgṛhītvā homasaṃbhāraṃ vrajet prayatamānasaḥaiśānyāṃ diśi deveśi likhecchrīcakramuttamamtato mantraṃ japet siddhamaṣṭottaraśatāvadhihastaikavistṛtaṃ cādho hastaikaparimāṇataḥṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatraṃ ca trivṛttaṃ bhūgṛhāṅkitamyathoktavidhinā yena sādhako dīkṣito bhavetcaturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥvartulī [g: vārtālī] vīrasūrvāmyā pūjyā aṣṭadalasthitāḥṣaṭkoṇamadhyagāḥ pūjyāḥ kuṇḍacakre maheśvarisvāhābhagavatīṃ bindau jātavedasamarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāraṃ vahniḥ śivo'bdhiśca hṛjjaṃ śaktirmaheśvaribhāsvareti trinetreti jvālāmukha padaṃ vadetṭhadvayaṃ saṃvadedante mantro'yaṃ vahnivallabhaḥgandhākṣataprasūnaiśca dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥtatra saṃpūjya deveśi śrīcakraṃ navayonikamtato devi pramathyāgniṃ kuṇḍacakre kuleśvariagniṃ sandīpya mūlena praṇamed vahnimudrayāaṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā dadyādājyena pārvatimatsyaṇḍaśarkarācandraiḥ kastūrīdṛṣadaṅkitaiḥpañca vā nava vā devi tathaikādaśa vā śivedṛḍhavratāñchubhācārān devībhaktiratāṃstathātatra saṃpūjya vidhivaj jñātvā bhairavasannibhāntān saṃpūjya mahādevi daśāṃśaṃ homamācaretkulasādhakapūjāyāṃ saṃśayaṃ chetumarhasiathavā kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vā vada vistarātnivṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthakna puraścaraṇārcāyāṃ tatra sarve dvijottamāḥdṛḍhavrataḥ śubhācāraḥ kulīnaḥ śivapūjakaḥtatra homaṃ ca saṃpādya dadyānnaivedyamādarātpūjayet kṣatriyo vīro bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥnaivedyācamanīyādyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca lehyakaiḥsādhakaḥ kṣatriyaṃ vīraṃ dātāraṃ vīrasevakamkulacakragatā virāḥ kulacakraprapūjakāḥkṣatriyo'pi mahādevi kulasaṅghān kulārthavitiha loke śriyaṃ prāpya bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ vidhāya mantrajño homaṃ japaphalāptayevarṇalakṣajapasyaivaṃ phalamāpnoti kaulikaḥsaṃhāramudrayā devīṃ visṛjya saśivāṃ śiveaprakāśyamadātavyamityājñā pārameśvarīpuraścaryāhomavidhinirūpaṇamekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥśrīcakranirṇayaṃ nāma paṭalaṃ devadurlabhamyasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥdevīnāṃ ca tathā devi trayastriṃśatikoṭayaḥpūrvoktā yā mahādevi tāsāṃ mantrottamāñchṛṇusarvārthasādhakaṃ devi sarvāśāparipūrakambālādicakramidamārtiharaṃ girīśabrahmendraviṣṇunamitaṃ gaditaṃ mayā tesakalāgamasārāḍhyamāpaduddhāraṇakṣamamśrīcakraṃ te varṇitaṃ bhairavīyamsarvasaṃmonaṃ devi sarvasiddhipravartakambhaktyābhīṣṭaphalapradaṃ kaliyuge śrīcakramuddyotatevṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥsarvārthasiddhidaṃ loke sarvakāmaprapūrakambravīmi dayayā devi sarvasārasvatapradamyatheṣṭaphaladaṃ śrībhadrakālīpriyam [kh, g: bhaiṃ]devadevi tava prītyā nacānyatra prakāśayetbhūmandiraṃ pārvati vahnirekhaṃ mātaṅginīyantramidaṃ pradiṣṭamprītyā bhaktyā maheśāni nacākhyeyaṃ mahātmabhiḥśrīcakrametad bhuvaneśvarīpriyambhogamokṣapradaṃ devi gopyaṃ kuru maheśvarisabhūpuraṃ caikajaṭāvilāsagehaṃ mayā yantramidaṃ pradiṣṭam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pravakṣyāmi tava prītyā na vaktavyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥvasvaśrayuktaṃ dharaṇīgṛhaṃ syāt śrīcakrametat paradevatāyāḥsumukhyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ na deyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥśrīcakraṃ sumukhīpriyaṃ vijayatād bhogāpavargapradamsarasvatyāḥ kaulikānāṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradammayoktaṃ hi sārasvataṃ yantrametatsarvasaṃmohanaṃ devi sarvabhogaikasādhanamdharāmandiraṃ cānnapūrṇeṣṭacakramyamabhyarcya mayā prāptaṃ durlabhaṃ paramaṃ padamśrīcakraṃ paramārthadāyi ca mahālakṣmīpriyaṃ siddhidamśārikāyā mahādevi līlālayalayākulamyantrametaduditaṃ śilālayamsarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakambhūgehaṃ syācchāradāyantrametatindrākṣyāstattvasarvasvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu gopitambhūgehabimbamanalenaśaśiprabhābhamindrākṣiṇīpriyataraṃ jayacakrametatsarvasiddhipradaṃ devi gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥvṛttatrayaṃ bhūsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametad bagalāmukhīyambravīmi paramaprītyā sakalābhīṣṭasādhanamdharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍyaṃ turyālayaṃ cakramidaṃ pradiṣṭamsarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvasaṃmohanaṃ tathāvṛttatrayaṃ dharāsadma rājñīśrīcakramīritamsarvatattvaikanilayaṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakamjvālāmukhyā jagati jayatāccakrametanmaheśisarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛttatrayaṃ bhūmigehatrayāḍhyaṃ bhīḍāyantraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ syātyantroddhāraṃ parānandasādhanaikarasāyanammūlamantrarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakamvṛttatrayaṃ bhūsadanatrayaṃ syāt śrīcakramānandapadaṃ bhavānyāḥśrīvajrayoginīdevyāḥ sarvasaukhyapravardhanamdharāgṛhaṃ yantramidaṃ maheśi śrīvajraśabdāṅkitayoginīyamsarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sādhakānāṃ śubhāvahamsarvavairipraśamanaṃ sarvavāñchitapūrakamtrivṛttaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ yantraṃ siddhalakṣmyā mayā smṛtamsādhakeṣṭapradaṃ divyaṃ parapadarasālayam[ṅ: rīṣṭam]sarvārthasādhakaṃ divyaṃ sarvāśāparipūrakamsarvadevarahasyaṃ ca gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥdharāgṛhaṃ sarvarahasyagarbhaṃ śrīkubjikāyantramidaṃ mayoktamsarvaiśvaryapradaṃ sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ śivebhūmandiraṃ kaulakuleṣṭatattvabhūtaṃ sucakraṃ kathitaṃ hi gauryāḥyogināṃ durlabhaṃ yogasādhanānandakāraṇamdharāgṛhaṃ mayākhyātaṃ khecarīyantramuttamammahācīnapadasthānāṃ siddhidaṃ bhogadaṃ śivedharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍyaṃ yantraṃ paraṃ nīlasarasvatīyamsarvasaṃpatpradaṃ divyaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakambhūgṛhaṃ yantrametatte parāśaktermayā smṛtamsarvasādhāraṇaṃ sarvavāñchitaikapradāyakamśaivamsarvasādhāraṇaṃ loke vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhapradam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gururaghoro vakṣye'haṃ tasya yantramanuttamamcaturbhūgṛhodbhāsitaṃ vahnirekhaṃ sadoddyotate'ghoradevasya yantramlakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭhastasya yantraṃ bravīmyahamṣoḍaśāraṃ ravṛttaṃ ca bhūgehenopaśobhitamtattvaṃ tava mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivatyantradhāraṇapūjāyā vidhiṃ sādhāraṇaṃ paramna siddhiḥ sādhakasyāsti bhairavasyāpi pārvatisā vidyā koṭijaptāpi tasya niṣphalatāṃ vrajetbrāhmye muhūrte utthāya snātvā dhyātvā guruṃ nijamgandhāṣṭakena vilikhed yantraṃ mūlena veṣṭitamlikhet kanakalekhanyā bhūrjapatre suśobhaneavācyaṃ devabhaktāya paraśiṣyāya sarvathākarpūraṃ mṛganābhiśca madyaṃ ca malayodbhavamvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śaivānāṃ śāktānāṃ ca śubhāvahambhairavi bhairaveṣṭam]nyāsamṛṣyādikaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyed devīṃ śivāṅkagāmmātṛkā vilikhenmantrī tadbāhye kavacaṃ likhetveṣṭayet śvetasūtreṇa pītanīlakrameṇa calākṣayā pariveṣṭyātha suvarṇenātha veṣṭayetyantradhāraṇa yantrasya bindau saṃsthāpayecchivekaulikānāṃ hitārthāya gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥtrivṛttaṃ ca dharāsadma yantradhāraṇa yantrakamyasya pūjanamātreṇa mantrī bhairavatāṃ vrajetcaturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥkarālaṃ vikarāla ca supteśonmattabhairavau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: durgāṃ caṇḍīṃ ca sumukhīṃ śivādūtīṃ śivāṃ jayāmtārāṃ ca tāriṇīṃ turyāṃ bagalāṃ vijayāṃ tathābhavānī kubjikā gaurī tryaśre pūjyā maheśvarigandhākṣataprasūnaiśca dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥtatra bindau mahādevi yathāvibhavamātmanaḥdevatāprītaye dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ gurave'pi capañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snāpayet sādhakottamaḥprāṇān dattvā''vāhanādimudrā mantrī pradarśayetcintayed devatārūpāṃ pūjayed yantrarājavatmūlamantraṃ yathāśaktyā mālayā karamālayāstotraṃ mantramayaṃ devi mantricakraṃ [g: mantra] prapūjayettān santarpya sudhīrbhaktyā dhārayed devatāṃ hṛdidhārayenmūrdhnī vā bāhau guṭikāṃ varadāyinīmsākṣād bhavabhayonmukto bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥbahunoktena kiṃ devi sa bhaved bhairavaḥ svayamsārāt sārataraṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥpaṭalaḥtathā devīśvarādīnāṃ devatābījanirṇayamdevīnāmādidevānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ me rahasyakamdevānāṃ mantrarājasya devīnāṃ vā tathaiva catathābdaṣaṣṭilakṣāṇi ṣaṣṭijanmāntareṣu caṛṣihīno bhavenmantro japto janmāntareṣu cayadā mantro mayā vaktrānmahādevi bahiṣkṛtaḥchandāṃsi vividhānyeṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ parameśvariyadā japto manurdevi mayā paramabhaktitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrarājasya devīnāṃ [kh: devānāṃ] yenotpattirmayā kṛtābījahīno bhavenmantraḥ siddhihānikaraḥ śivejapānte jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārikī matiḥśaktihīno mahādevi mantro vighnakaro mataḥjaptvā stutvā mahādevi punaryena sa gopitaḥniṣkīlitaṃ japānte ca manumaśraddhayā śivejapakāle mahādevi rākṣasā bhūtapretakāḥdigbandhena [kh: bandhane] vinā devi japaḥ pāṭho'pi vā tathāetairvihīno mantro'sti niṣphalo vighnakārakaḥgopanīyo mahāvīrairityājñā pārameśvarīyena sādhanamātreṇa sādhako bhairavo bhavetvismṛto'yaṃ vidhirguhyaḥ śmaśānasyārcanāṅkitaḥnāmabhirviśrutā devi bhavatyā me paraṃ śrutāḥsādhakā yena jāyante sarvasiddhiyutāḥ śivena siddhyanti varārohe kalau bhairavaśāpataḥtatra gatvārcayed yastu sa bhaved bhairavopamaḥsārameyaiśca yakṣendraiḥ soragaiḥ sapiśācakaiḥtatra bhūtā mahāghorāścatvāro vighnakārakāḥte saṃmukhagatāḥ krūrā bhūtāḥ kurvanti vipriyamteṣāṃ vidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyaṃ sārottamottamamravau candre kuje saumye gurau śukre śanau tathāmahogra citrāṅgada caṇḍa bhāsvallolākṣa bhūteśa karāla bhīmāḥetān samabhyarcya vaset śmaśāne syādanyathā dhībhramaṇaṃ vipattiḥpañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥgadyapadyamayīṃ devi mantrasiddhipradāyinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śmaśānārcanasaṃbhāraṃ samādāya ca sānugaḥtatra devi vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārvati sādaramguhyaṃ sāratamaṃ gopyaṃ nākhyeyaṃ siddhivāñchakaiḥprāṇiprāṇālayodbhūte cite me'nugrahaṃ kurukathaṃ saṃdhārayen mantrī tatra saṃmukhapṛṣṭhayoḥvakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ durātmaneeva vāyaukarālako nirṛtigo'pi mande ravau punaḥ paścimago'pi bhīmaḥsudhāṃśuvṛddhau śaśihīnapakṣe tadvaiparītyena śive bhramantikathaṃ devi kariṣyanti dvayorbhāskaravārayoḥravivāraṃ ca saṃguṇya prathamaṃ vā dvitīyakamdvitīye paścime bhīmaṃ pūjayecchuklapakṣakeadhunaiṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjāsāraṃ maheśvariśmaśānapūjāmantrasya mahākāla ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥparā bījaṃ taṭaṃ śaktiḥ kālī kīlakamīritamsurāpānavidhiṃ brūhi yena siddhirbhaved dhruvamsādhakā yena jāyante kalau bhairavasannibhāḥvinā pānaṃ na siddhiḥ syāt sādhakānāṃ kalau dhruvamteṣu brahmādayo devā nilīnā muktaye paramtatra sarve sthitā devā vāsavādyā aharniśamtatra pānaṃ parādevyā mahānandapradāyakamna siddhyati śive mantraḥ śmaśānārcāṃ vinā tathāpānaṃ bhajet parādevyāḥ śrīcakrāgre yathāvidhiahorātre surāpānaṃ bhogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śivesa vaiṣṇavaḥ sa śāktaśca sa śaivo yaḥ śmaśānagaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pānaṃ tāvadbhajed devi yāvat saṃvinmanomayīyāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥvinā pūjāṃ caredyastu pānaṃ vā carvaṇādikamsa rogī [sa bhogī iti sādhuḥ pāṭhaḥ] nindito loke parapiṇḍopajīvakaḥātmocchiṣṭaṃ na dātavyaṃ parocchiṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayetsiddhihānirbhavet sadyo yoginyo bhakṣayanti tamabhyarcya vidhinā pānaṃ kṛtvā carvaṇapūrvakampānaṃ pānaṃ śive pānaṃ saptavāraṃ samuccaretityeṣā paddhatirguhyā śmaśānārcanasaṃyutātava snehena vikhyātā na prakāśyā kadācanaaprakāśyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivatpaṭalaḥśrīdevyā yantrarājasya mālākaṅkaṇayorapiyena śuddhirbhaved deva dravyāṇāṃ sādhakasya hisarvasādhāraṇaṃ loke paṭalaṃ guhyamuttamamkapālaṃ naradantānāṃ mālā kaṅkaṇamīśvaripunaraṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tenaiva tarpayetśmaśānabhasmaliptena śuddhena suravanditemālāṃ kuryānnṛdantānāṃ sakalābhīṣṭasiddhayeyantraṃ mālāṃ śive tasya mantrahānirbhaved dhruvamśmaśānabhasma śuddhaṃ ca kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥkapālayantraṃ deveśi keśakaṅkaṇamuttamamgopayet sādhako'tyantaṃ devīrūpaṃ vicintayetanyathā siddhihāniḥ syānmamāpi parameśvariaprakāśyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṭalaḥśodhanaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistarāt paramārthadamśodhanasya hi dravyāṇāṃ mālādīnāṃ maheśvarikaṅkaṇaṃ dantamālāṃ ca yantraṃ kāpālikaṃ śivemakārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayed bhairaveśvarīmpañcagavyamiti prājyaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥpūtāsamevaṃ malayodbhavaṃ ca sadyantraśuddhau mahadauṣadhāniyantre devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayet sādhakottamaḥvāmācāraḥ [g, gh: kaulā] paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥyadi tatra vikāraḥ syāt pānaṃ tad brahmaghātavatretasā tarpayed devīṃ śaktiṃ pānena tarpayetmakārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ kuryācchrīcakramaṇḍalamsantarpya devatāmiṣṭāṃ miṣṭānnaiścarvaṇaiḥ śivesantoṣayitvā svaguruṃ dakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥsakalāgamasārāḍhyāṃ gopayet sādhakottamaḥpaṭalaḥyasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyāttatrotpannā surādevī kumārīrūpadhāriṇīaṣṭādaśabhujā divyā navakumbhadharā tathānānākusumabhūṣāḍhyā muktakeśī trilocanāraktātnāṅgulīyaśobhāḍhyā tuṅgāpīnastanāñcitāratnasiṃhāsanagatā paramānandadāyinīsasurāsuragandharvāḥ seśvarāḥ sasadāśivāḥādau pātraṃ dadau divyamānandarasapūritampātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātā guḍalatāstataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ikṣubhedāśca khadirāstryūṣaṇādyāḥ sitādayaḥgauḍī caitadyutā proktā sarvārthaphaladāyinīpātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ tato jātāhivallarīmṛdvīkādyā mahādevi jātāḥ paramapāvanāḥtato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ rudrāyāmṛtapūritamtatkaṇebhyo bhadantī ca jātā vai dhānyajātayaḥtato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇavetatkaṇebhyo'pi deveśi tadbhedāḥ kanakādayaḥvijayeti mayā proktā vaiṣṇavī paramārthadātato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ śrīsurā parameṣṭhinetatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedāḥ kṣaudrarasādayaḥpūritaṃ]tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedāścāmalakādayaḥtato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ gurave girije surājātaṃ tatkaṇajā bhedā nārikelaphalādayaḥtato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ śukrāyāmṛtapūritambhādhāmakādayaḥ]tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā vividhauṣadhayaḥ śivesarvārthaphaladaṃ devi sarvasārasvatapradamte sarve parameśāni surānandaikanirbharāḥye pibanti paraṃ pānaṃ paramānandakāraṇamvinā gauḍīṃ tathā mādhvīṃ surāṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivāmadīkṣitaḥ paśurdevi dīkṣito'pyasuraḥ paśuḥpivedgauḍīṃ tathā mādhvīṃ paiṣṭīmāsavamuttamamānandeśvarasarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkālaṃ yadvadānandapātraṃ devaiśca vanditamguruṇā dattamabhyarcya praṇamecchirasā tadādvitīyamadhunānandaikasaṃvardhanamvande pātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā svātmāvabodhakṣamamsurāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥ [gh: sevitaṃ]srīmadbhairavabhairavīpriyataraṃ pātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ numaḥmāmpātraṃ lakṣaguṇātmakaṃ ca navamaṃ prauḍhapratāpaṃ bhajedurlabhaṃ pāvanaṃ pātraṃ daśamaṃ praṇamāmyahampātramekādaśaṃ vande gurusevāsukhāgatamiha loke śriyaṃ bhuktvā dehānte bhairavo bhavetpibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum [k: samaṃ mākṣikam]hṛdaye tripurā bālā yāgaśālā gṛhe gṛheyogināmapyagamyaḥśivo'hambhaktirgurupadāmbhoje śaraṇaṃ [kh: smaraṇaṃ] kimataḥ paramsāgareṇasurasaṃ te bhuktimuktī gatāḥpunarutthāya vai pītvā punarjanma na vidyatesuṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyahamtāvat pānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paśupānamataḥ parampaṭalaḥvīrā yena parānandapadaṃ prāpsyanti niḥspṛhāḥnamāmi śirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyamnamaḥ śrīnāthavaidyāya kulauṣadhapradāyine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāntirmanorathaścāstu pāntu sarvāśca devatāḥbhagavān kuleśaḥviśeṣapadabhedakaśāmbhavā yeṣaḍyoginīpravaravīrakulaprasūtā nandantu bhūmipatigodvijasādhulokāḥśāntamanaso hṛtaśokaśaṅkāḥripubhakṣaṇodyamaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥkulamārgapālanaparāḥ śāntiṃ prayacchantu meprityā devyaḥ sadā vaḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu virendravandyāḥyogīśāścāraṇāḥ kiṃpuruṣamunisurāścakragāḥ pāntu sarvesantyatrāpi ca kaulikāśca yadi cet syānme jayaḥ sarvadāyoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥkālāgnyādiśivāntaṃ ca jagadyajñena tṛpyatusamuddhṛtakleśamahoragebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥsarvaprajābhyuddharaṇodyatebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥjarārujāmṛtyunivārakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥsarvatra saṃpūrṇamanorathebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥsarvārthacaryāparipūrakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥprajñāpratijñāparipūrakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥvistīrṇasarvārthaguṇākarebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥparasparānugrahakārakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥsamastasaubhāgyakalākarebhyo namo namaḥ kāraṇanāyakebhyaḥśrīvīracaryācaraṇakṣamebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥadvaitatattvāmṛtabhājanebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥprataptacāmīkaravigrahebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥmahākṛpāveṣṭitamānasebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svātantryavidhvastajagattamobhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥparasparājñāparipālakebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥnavīnakāntārata tatparebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥbhairavibhairavebhyaḥsvādhīnatānyakkṛtanirjarebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥnirastaniḥśeṣavikalpanebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥśrīsaccidānanditavigrahebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥśivo'hamityāśritacetanebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥjagajjanitavistāraṃ brahmedamiti vedmyahammatprāṇe sa tu maccātmā līnaḥ samarasīgataḥśivādvayaprakāśāḍhyaṃ śyāmalaṃ dhāma dhīmahisaṃsārakāntāramahārṇave'sminnimajjamānaṃ jagaduddhareyamnirūpaṇamekaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥyaṃ vidhāya kalau mantrī bhavitā muktibhājanamśuddhaistaireva pūjāyāṃ bhavedbhogāpavargabhāktadā sarve surā devi brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥasurā rākṣasā yakṣā gandharvā mānavādayaḥkālena kalaśasthābhūt surādevī sureśvariśaptā śukreṇa deveśi kacakāraṇahatyayābrahmarṣayaḥ surādevyai daduḥ śāpaṃ yathākramamsurā śaptā yadā devaistadā daityā mudaṃ yayuḥsvargānnirākṛtā devi purandarapuraḥsarāḥsadāśivādayo devi prādurbhūtā makhottametaṃ tavāśu prayacchāmo gacchāmo nilayaṃ svakamtṛṇāgrabindumātreṇa surāyāḥ prāśitena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sā śaptā brahmaṇā devī viṣṇunā śaṅkareṇa catadā sarve surā devaṃ śivamīśvaramavyayamekākṣarāya rudrāya akārāyātmarūpiṇetṛtīyāya makārāya śivāya paramātmanenamaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejaseśivāya kṣitirūpāya sadāsurabhaye [gh: bhide] namaḥpaśūnāṃ pataye caiva pāvakāmitatejasemahādevāya somāya amṛtāya namo namaḥiti stutvā paraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ śivamīśvaramtadā vāgudabhūd vyomnaḥ pañcavyomaśarīriṇāmyuktyānayā prasaṅgena yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥatharvāhaṃ ca mantrātmā paramātmā śivo'vyayaḥkurukullāṃ mahāvidyāṃ sadāśiva prakāśayatasmin surādiśuddhiṃ tu prakāśaya manūttamaiḥsadāśivaṃ maheśānaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ surāḥnamo devādidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥvedaśāstrārthagamyāya śāśvatāya namo namaḥnamaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya namaḥ sāhasrikāṅghrayeiti stutvā mahādevo mahātmā śrīsadāśivaḥdevadevīti yā devī yā bhavānīti viśrutāvada devāgamaṃ śāstraṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutammakārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śodhanaṃ siddhivardhanamvedārthāgamatattvajñaiḥ surā sevyā mumukṣubhiḥśāstrāṇāṃ parameśāni bhrāntiḥ kāryā na kaulikaiḥyena śodhanamātreṇa sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṅkumenāṣṭagandhena sarvathā vīrabhasmanāsāmānyārghyodakenāśu saṃprokṣya kulasundarivahneḥ kalāḥ samabhyarcya yathāvadvarṇyate mayādaśakalātmane viśvamiti mantreṇa pūjayetjvālā haimavatī kavyavāhanī havyavāhanīpūjayitvoktavidhinā gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥhaimaṃ vā rājataṃ mārdaṃ sthāpayed vīramudrayābrahmaṇā ca yathā pūrvaṃ tathā tvāṃ sthāpayāmyahamsūryanāma samuccārya jīvamantraṃ maheśvariviśvamante prayoktavyaṃ manunānena pūjayettapinī tāpinī caiva bodhinī caiva rodhinīmāyā viśvāvatī hemaprabhā saurakalā imāḥsurayā pūrayet kumbhaṃ vilomairmātṛkākṣaraiḥcandramaṇḍalamabhyarcya mantreṇānena pārvativiśvāñcalāya deveśi śrīṣoḍaśakalātmaneamṛtā mānadā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ prītī ratistathāchāyā ca pūrṇimā nityā cāmāvasyā ca ṣoḍaśīmūlena tatra kalaśe trikoṇaṃ ca vibhāvayetpraṇavenārcayed devi śivaṃ gandhena vāyunāparamākāśaśūnyaṃ ca vāhinīti samuddharetṭhadvayāntāmimāṃ vidyāṃ japettu daśadhā ghaṭeākṛṣṇena rajaseti nāmnīṃ paramapāvanīmtatrānandeśagāyatrīṃ japettu daśadhā priyevidmahe śrīsurādevyai dhīmahīti tato vadetgāyatrīṃ daśadhā japtvā haṃsaḥ śuciṣadārcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vakāraṃ dīrghaṣaṭkādyaṃ proccārya tadanantaramdaśadhā prajapedvidyāmiṣe tvorjetyṛcaṃ japetśukraśāpaṃ mocaya dvirvanāntaṃ ca manuṃ japetśukraśāpaharīṃ vidyāṃ prajapeducyate yathā [kh: mayā]amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatāmtena satyena deveśi brahmahatyā vyapohatukacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyahamvimuktā rudraśāpena pavitrā bhava sāṃpratamśanno devīriti ṛcaṃ daśadhā prajaped ghaṭechurikākāriṇyuccārya śobhinīti tato vadetchurikākhyāṃ japedvidyāṃ daśadhā kalaśopariguruṃ dhyātvā sahasrāre hṛtpadme'pīṣṭadevatāmnīlatoyadasaṅkāśāṃ nīlakuntalaśobhitāmnīlapuṣpavibhūṣāḍhyāṃ nīlālaṅkārabhūṣitāmindranīlanibaddhāṃśumahārghamaṇibūṣitāmnidrāpaṭena nīlena bhuvanāni caturdaśavīrapānaratān vīrān pālayantīṃ samantataḥparamānandavapuṣīṃ paramānandabhairavīmiti dhyātvā japedvidyāṃ yathāvad varṇyate mayāsakalajanaṃ proccārya vāgvādini tato vadetcakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇādīni ceti tiraskuruśrītiraskaraṇīṃ vidyāṃ sañjaped daśadhā ghaṭepāvamānyaṃ paraṃ brahma pāvamānyaḥ paro rasaḥiti japtvā guruṃ dhyātvā japed varuṇabījakamprasuptabhujagākārāṃ sārdhatrivalayāṃ śubhām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahnikoṭidurāda(dha)rṣāṃ bisatantutanīyasīmsahasrārasthitaṃ devaṃ natvā śivapade layetamṛtaṃ vāmanāsāgrānniḥsārya kalaśe kṣipetmāyāṃ ramāṃ kāmakalāmamṛte'pyamṛtodbhaveaṃāṃ viṣṇukalānte ca paṭhet pārvati kaulikaḥdhyātvāmṛtamayaṃ dravyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitamvidhāya mūlamantreṇa tīrthānyāvāhayed ghaṭegaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvatiityāvāhya mahādevi mudrayāṅkuśarūpayādravyamadhye binduyutaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca vibhāvayetsūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalamamṛtārṇavamadhyasthaṃ brahmapadmoparisthitamkapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamaruvādinamkhaḍgakheṭakapaṭṭīśa mudgarocchūlakuntinamlohitaṃ devadeveśaṃ bhāvayet sādhakottamaḥhakāraṃ ca bhṛguṃ devaṃ maṇḍūkaṃ dharaṇiṃ tataḥvāyuṃ keśaṃ tathānandabhairavāya tato'ñcaleānandabhairavīṃ dhyāyed yathāvad varṇyate [g: varṇitā] śivetatrotpannā surā devī kumārīrūpadhāriṇīhimakundendudhavalāṃ pañcavaktrāṃ trilocanāmprahasantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ devadevasya sammukhīmmeghaṃ vahniṃ samīrārṇaṃ keśaṃ caiva samuddharetbhairavaṃ bhairavīṃ caiva yaṣṭvā pārvati kaulikaḥbaddhvā ca lelihānākhyāṃ mudrāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ punaḥdvādaśāntaṃ samāsthāpya sohaṃ haṃsa iti smaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadudbhūtāmṛtavṛṣṭimutsṛjed vāmanāsayāsākṣādamṛtatattvāḍhyaṃ dhyāyet kalaśamuttamamdaśadhā prajaped devi gandhākṣatapuraḥsaraiḥsaṃpūjya kalaśaṃ divyaṃ ghaṇṭāniḥsvānapūrvakamprapūjtha parayā bhaktyā praṇāmaiḥ stutipūrvakaiḥyā surā sā umādevī yo dravyaṃ sa maheśvaraḥsvāde ca saṃsthitaḥ somaṃ phenāyāmanalaḥ sthitaḥdrāve gaṅgā sthitā devi ghaṭasthāḥ sapta sāgarāḥsarvaśāpavinirmuktaṃ sarvamantrasusaṃskṛtammāheśvarairmahāvīrairmahācīnapadasthitaiḥsantarpya devatāmiṣṭāṃ yoginīgaṇamaiśvarammātṝrmātṛgaṇān sarvān bhūtapretādisaṃyutānguruṃ dhyātvā parāṃ dhyāyedvīrān saṃpūjya śaktitaḥśaktihīne vṛthāpānaṃ śivahīne vṛthārcanamitīdaṃ śodhanaṃ divyaṃ surāyāṃ suradurlabhammadyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā mīno mudrā maithunameva capūjāyāṃ yadyadānītaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyakamvinābhimantraṇenaitad yo mohād bhakṣayecchivecaturasraṃ likhedbimbaṃ tatra mīnān nidhāpayetvāyubījena vāhnyena vāruṇena yathākramamdaśadhā prajapenmantramānandeśvarabhairavamkṛtāvatāro hariṇā kalinā pīḍitaṃ jagatbhairavīparitoṣārthaṃ svayaṃ mīno'bhavad hariḥtryambakaṃ yajāmahīti mantraṃ triḥsañjapet sudhīḥcaturasre mahādevi māṃsapātraṃ nidhāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudrātrayaṃ pradarśyāśu prapaṭhet kauliko manumbalyarthaṃ śivaśaktyostaṃ prapadye viṣṇumavyayamtriḥ paṭhitvā ṛcaṃ devi japet kaulikasattamaḥmudrāpātraṃ samānīya sthāpayeccaturaśrakemudrātrayaṃ ca saṃdarśya prapaṭhed vedavad vidhimbalyarthaṃ devadevyośca pavitrāṇīha siddhaye(tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ prajapyopari kaulikaḥcaturaśre ca saṃsthāpya śoṣayed dāhayet sudhīḥmūlaṃ ca daśadhā japtvā japedṛcamathoparisarveṣu devadravyeṣu samānīteṣu kaulikaiḥglūṃmlūṃslūṃplūṃnlūṃ deveśi svāntaṃ khaṃ kāmakālikamsrāvaya dvayamuddhṛtya ṭhadvayaṃ ca samuddharetpañcānāṃ pañcakalpānāṃ smaraṇīyārcanāvidhauṛgbhiḥ krameṇa mūlena plā(pā)vayecca yathākramamevaṃ saṃśodhya dravyāṇi paramāṇi kuleśvariayaṣṭvā bhairavaṃ devamakṛtvā devatārcanamevaṃ saṃskṛtya deveśi gurubhaktipuraḥsaramitīdaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyānāṃ rahasyakampaṭalaḥyena [g: yasya] śravaṇamātreṇa parāśaktipade layettatkathāśravaṇaṃ cet syāt tattalpagamanaṃ yadisa kulīnaḥ kathaṃ deva pūjayet kulayoṣitamkṛte'pi siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikāratikāle maheśānī dīkṣākāle ca kanyakāsurayā retasā vāpi jalena madhunātha vā

sanskrit: svakīyāṃ parakīyāṃ vā rūpayauvanagarvitāmkulayogī kathaṃ kuryācchodhanaṃ kulayoṣitāmvidhāya mānasīṃ pūjāṃ mantraṃ yogī samuccaretkutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtya vibhāvayetsarvathā naiva kartavyamanyathā siddhirodhakṛtstrīgaṇeṣu sadā bhāvyamanyathā svastriyāmapisādhakasya bhavedāśu kāmadhenurivāparātatparaḥ paratanvīnāṃ paratattve pralīyatebrāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakāetāsu kāṃcidānīya saṃśodhanamathācaretśaktiśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ sadāśivaḥvāgbījaṃ bījamīśāni śaktiḥ śaktiritīritābhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogo maheśvariekādaśa navāṣṭau vā kaulikaḥ kaulikeśvarisādhakaḥ saṃspṛśedādau kṛtvā viṣṭaraśodhanammantrasaṃkalpakaṃ kṛtvā munyādinyāsamācarethṛtpīṭhārcāṃ vidhāyātha [ṅ: yātra] śrīcakrārcanamācaretvīrārcanaṃ vīrakāntāsevanaṃ devadurlabhamśaktiṃ vāme tu saṃsthāpya pūjayedvarṇyate yathāśivatryaśraṃ kāmatryaśraṃ hetitryaśraṃ maheśvariśrīcakreṣu hi naṭyādimālinyantaṃ vicārya catadīyaṃ yantramālikhya tasmiṃstāmeva pūjayetmuktakeśīṃ vītalajjāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmānandalīnahṛdayāṃ saundaryātimanoharāmbālābījatrayaṃ devi proccārya tadanantaraṃ

sanskrit: ratena tarpayet tatra śrīcakre vīrasaṃsadidharmādharmahavirdīpte svātmāgnau manasā srucāsvāhāntamantramuccārya japan mūlaṃ smaran parāmratānte sañjapenmūlaṃ paṭhenmantramimaṃ punaḥprakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucamsvāhāntenāśu mantreṇa śukramādāya pārvatisaṃpūjya kāntāṃ santarpya stutvā natvā parasparamitīdaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ śaktiśodhanamuttamamtrayorviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥyena śodhanamātreṇa mālā siddhyati satphalākiyatphalā kiyatsaṃkhyā sarvaṃ me vaktumarhasimālā japasya deveśi rahasyamidamaiśvaramdvādaśātmā sa savitā tadantāvṛttirīritāāvartayecca navadhā tāmeva japasiddhayemālārahasyasarvasvaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacitkṛtvā meruṃ mahārudraṃ japamālā vinirmitāanyathā japahāniḥ syādrudrasya vacanaṃ yathāpāyuṃ pāyau nibadhnīyāt sūtre mantramanusmaranśaṅkhamuktāpravālārka rudrākṣavaravīrudhāmsarveṣāṃ golakānāṃ ca meruṃ rudrākṣamācaretṣaṇmāsenākṣasūtrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ sādhakaścaretṣaṭtriṃśattattvagolakānaṣṭotkṛṣṭaśate prauḍhā māleyaṃ devi durlabhāvarṇitā mātṛkāmālā vedādihavirāśritātāradvayaṃ ca vargānte varṇādyante ca taddvayam

sanskrit: tārakāmaiḥ saṃpuṭitā māleyaṃ guruvallabhāṣaḍānanodbhavāstārāḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍāmnāyasūcakāḥrudrākṣāṇāṃ prakurvīta mālāṃ sarvārthasiddhidāmpūrvāmnāyādibhedānāṃ mālāṃ kuryādyathākramamtārakāmena saṃyojya brahmotkṛṣṭaśataṃ śivesvaravargayaśāṁllāntān yojayet parameśvariśrīmahāṣoḍaśīvidyāgurūnādāya pārvatiśivāmāleyamākhyātā śivasāyujyasiddhayetryadhikairyojayenmālā bhairavīyamudāhṛtāanāmikādvayaṃ parva kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa tukaniṣṭhikācatuṣparvānāmāparvatrayaṃ tathāsaṃyojya saṃjaped vidyāṃ mantrī dvādaśaparvasudurgāvṛttyā japed devi sahasrādyayutāvadhipralambaparvatritaye trayo devāḥ samāhitāḥkulikaśceti vikhyāto japahānikaro mataḥkaniṣṭhāmūlaparvādikrameṇa karagāḥ surāḥīśāno'gnirnir-ṛtiśca vāyurindro yamastathābrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥmudgarollaṅghane śaktirmahārudrasya kevalamanyathā devi mantrī ca devatāśāpamāpnuyātyayā siddhirbhaved devi devānāmapi durlabhāvidhāya bhasmanā snānaṃ jalena mantritena vābhūtaśuddhikramopetaṃ prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ tataḥmālāśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ kālāgnirudrakaḥkālarātrīti vikhyātā muṇḍamālāvilāsinī

sanskrit: sūryākhyaṃ kīlakaṃ mālāśuddhaye viniyogakaḥaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāyātha karanyāsādipūrvakamprāṇān devi pratiṣṭhāpya śrīcakrārcanamācaretkṣetreśa yoginīvṛndaṃ santarpya kulasundarimālāyā devadeveśi yathāmnāyaṃ yathāvidhimālāmūleṇa deveśi mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥtāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ śaṅkhinīti padaṃ vadettāraṃ lajjā yugaṃ tāraṃ muktāmālini mā yugamtāraṃ vadhūṃ ca vedādyaṃ raudre ca rodhramālinitāraṃ mātrādyamuccārya sūryākhyabīja yugmakamtāramabdhiramāmāyāḥ sindhuṃ rudrākṣamālinitāraṃ tārātrayaṃ tāraṃ vadhūṃ tulasi vaiṣṇavivedādyaṃ kamalā kuntī vāgbījaṃ kāmaśaktikamtāraṃ ca vāyupūjyā ca tāraṃ padmākṣamālinitāratrayaṃ mā trayaṃ ca kāmarājatrayaṃ śivevadhūrvastraṃ vanaṃ mantro naradantaviśuddhikṛtmālāṃ saṃśodhya saṃpūjya mūlaṃ japtvā daśāṃśataḥṅ: parāśakti]svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvamālāviśodhanaḥme ṭhadvayaṃ mahāmantraḥ sadā [g: sarva] mālāviśodhanaḥmālāmādāya deveśi sañjapedardharātrakevada deva kathaṃ kuryāt kaulikaḥ sarvasiddhayemantro'yaṃ karamālāyāḥ śuddhidaḥ [g: kṛt] sarvasiddhidaḥtato japenmahāvidyāṃ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavettava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ

sanskrit: caturviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥvakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kaulikānāṃ hitāya cakāpālikaṃ ca pāśāsaṃ śrīcakraṃ vaiṣṇavāśmikamvibhāvayenmahāyantraṃ daivaṃ bhaumaṃ ca bhāvikamsiddhasādhyakampañcame pañcame devi tataḥ siddhipradaṃ bhavetcaturthe ca caturthe ca tataḥ siddhimavāpnuyātrājataṃ tāmrikaṃ yantraṃ ṣaṇmāsānte ca śodhayetsiddhaye kauliko devi yathāvadvarṇyate mayātriṣṭup chanda iti khyātaṃ parāśaktiśca devatāśrīcakraśuddhisiddhyarthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥtato viṣṭaraśuddhiṃ ca prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ caretvidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ layāṅganyāsasaṃyutammūlatrikhaṇḍakaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā prāṇacayaṃ śivesvarṇasiṃhāsane sthāpya śrīcakraṃ sveṣṭadaivatamaṣṭagandhena vā devi pauruṣeṇa rasena vāśrīcakraṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjayet tatra kaulikaḥyantraṃ sauvarṇamuddhṛtya śodhaya dvayamuddharettāraṃ sindhuṃ ca tāraṃ ca rājataṃ yantramuddharettāraṃ tārā ca tāraṃ ca vadhūṃ tāraṃ ca tārakāvedādyaṃ kamalāṃ māyāṃ tāraṃ yantraṃ kulāmbikepraṇavaṃ kūvarībījaṃ mā māyā vāyupūjitātāraṃ vāk kāmarājaśca śaktiḥ kapālamālinitāraṃ gaurī ca tārtīyaṃ vāk kāmaśca citāsanevedādyaṃ haritaṃ vāṇī śaktiḥ kāmo ramā ramā

sanskrit: ityevaṃ yantramīśāni ratnasiṃhāsanasthitamṅ: puṣpakaiḥ]yathoktāṃ sādhakaḥ kuryād dravyaśodhanapūrvakamniśīthakālaṃ me brūhi saṃśayo'yaṃ mahān mamaniśītho vārdharātraśca tṛtīyaiva mahāniśāmuhūrte dve samādāya tathā dve ca maheśvariardharātro muhūrte dve pūjārhaḥ parameśvariyāmadvayādardharātro varṇitaḥ kaulasiddhayetasyāṃ parāṃ japedyastu sa bhavecchivasannibhaḥmahāniśāyāṃ prajapet parāṃ kaulikasattamaḥrajaḥ śukraṃ surāṃ devi māṃsaṃ mīnaṃ ca maithunampibenmadyaṃ bhajedrāmāṃ smared bhairavibhairavamprātaḥkṛtyaṃ śive kṛtvā śrīcakraṃ pūjayet tataḥparāṃ japet sadā satyāṃ tato yāti paraṃ padammahāmohe mahā'saukhye mahādāridryasaṅkaṭedurāpadi durāśe ca durbhikṣe durnimittakevaktre sarasvatī tasya lakṣmīstasya gṛhe sadā [kh: tathā]mayoditaṃ tava snehānnākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥpañcaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥkuleśa śrotumicchāmi tantrasyāsyottarārdhakamtantrottarārdhaṃ vakṣyāmi rahasyavijayābhidhamdevadevīti yā khyātā [k: vikhyātā] gāyatrīti śrutau smṛtāpañcātmikā pañcamīśī pañcavyomaprakāśiniparādevīti yā durgā sā śivaḥ sā hariḥ smṛtāpañcamī pañcikā devī pañcamācāravartinī

sanskrit: pañcakṛtyamayī [k, kh, g: vedya] devī sarvadevīmayī śivāmahāśyāmā mahāvidyā pūjanīyā yathākramamgaṇeśārkaharīśāna durgāṇāṃ paramārthavitdevīcakre'rcayet sarvāṃśchivaliṅge'thavā śiveśrīgaṇeśvaracakreṇa ma bhedaṃ kārayed budhaḥpṛthak pṛthak śive kuryādarcanaṃ kaulikottamaḥśrīdevyā ugradurgāyā mantrī devīrahasyavit [k: vat]rahasyavijayaṃ nāma tantraṃ tantrottarārdhakamgaṇeśasya ca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ savitustathādurgādevyāśca pañcāṅgaṃ durgādevīrahasyakamsarvasvametad deveśi tantraṃ devīrahasyakamprathamaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ mahāgaṇapateḥ śṛṇumerupṛṣṭhe sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ trilocanamsiddhakinnaragandharvairyakṣabhūtapiśācakaiḥsasmitaṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ ca brahmaṇā hariṇā sahakāryasya devatānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva caavaktavyamabhaktebhyo bhaktebhyo muktisādhanamvighnakartā jagattrātā vighnaharteti viśrutaḥvighno na bādhate jātu [k: tasya] yastaṃ saṃpūjayet sadāpaṭhennāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu stotraṃ mūlaikasādhanammantraṃ yantraṃ stavaṃ varma nāmnāṃ sahasramuttamamgajānano gaṇādhyakṣo vināyaka iti śrutaḥtatrādau te pravakṣyāmi mantroddhāraṃ sureśvarihyaṣṭāviṃśativarṇako nigadito vaināyako'yaṃ manuḥvaṭe catuṣpathe śūnyagṛhe pretālaye caret

sanskrit: na kleśo naca durbuddhirna moho naca śokatāyantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāśāparipūrakamsuvṛttaṃ caturdvārayuktaṃ prayuktaṃ gajāsyasya śrīcakrametat prasiddhamyena smaraṇamātreṇa sarvo vighnaḥ palāyatedhyāyet siṃhayugāsanaṃ gaṇapatiṃ trailokyacintāmaṇimṣaḍvargabījabhāgena kalyanyāsaṃ caret tataḥpūjanaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitaṃ śarajanmanāpūrvapaścimayoḥ pūjyā dakṣiṇottarayostathāpuṣpadantavikartāntya cittalohitasundarāḥgaṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa saṃpūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśāreṣu sundarimahākālaṃ ca kālāgniṃ sitāsyamasitātmakamvināyakaṃ vighnarājaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gajānanamekadantaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ daśāreṣu prapūjayettrikoṇe pūjayedbindau mahāgaṇapatiṃ prabhumvighnāntakākhuvāhau ca tripurāntakamīśvariśatapatraṃ sahasrāraṃ dantamālāṃ maheśvariśaṅkhau saṃpūjayedbindau layāṅgamidamucyategāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devo gaṇapatiḥ smṛtaḥkurudvayaṃ kīlakaṃ syāt sarvamantraikasādhanamayutaṃ ca japenmūlaṃ hutvā sarpiryavāṅkuramayutaṃ ca japenmūlaṃ vaṭe hutvā citānalenadyāṃ sādhaka evāśu japedayutasaṃkhyayāvidveṣayecca brahmāṇaṃ girije nātra saṃśayaḥvaśayedapi rājānamākarṣayati yoṣitaḥsarvatantraikasarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: gadyaikasārasarvasvāmānandaikataraṅgiṇīmmahāgaṇapaterdivyāṃ sarvathā devi gopayetsaptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥkavacaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vajrapañjarakābhidhamkāruṇyenāntarāyāmitabhayaśamanaṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmivināyako lalāṭaṃ me vighnarājo bhruvau mamaśrutī me'vatu herambo gaṇḍau me modakāśanaḥdantān mamaikadanto'vyād vakratuṇḍao'vatād rasāmvighnāntako bhujau pātu hastau mūṣakavāhanaḥhṛdayaṃ me kumāro'vyājjayantaḥ pārśvayugmakamkaṭiṃ nandigaṇaḥ pātu śiśnaṃ vīreśvaro'vatuvirāṭako'vatādūrū jānū me puṣpadantakaḥpādau cittagaṇaḥ pātu pādādho lohito'vatuvicāro jaṭharaṃ pātu bhūtāni cograrūpakaḥpādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ vapuḥ pātu vinartakaḥpūrve māṃ hrīṃ karālo'vyādāgneye vikarālakaḥpaścime māṃ māhākālo vāyau kālāgnibhairavaḥprabhāte śatapatro'vyāt sahasrārastu madhyamekalaśo māṃ niśīthe'vyānniśānte paraśustathānityaṃ yakṣapiśācabhūtaphaṇiṣu glauṃgaṃ gaṇeśo'vatuvajrapañjaranāmānaṃ gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥvinānena na siddhiḥ syāt pūjanasya japasya catasya siddhirmahādevi karasthā pāralaukikīardharātre paṭhennityaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalaṃ labhetsarvasiddhimayaṃ divyaṃ [ṅ: pūjya] gopayet parameśvari

sanskrit: mahāgaṇapatikavacanirūpaṇamaṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥtava bhaktyā gaṇeśasya vakṣye nāmasahasrakamśrotuṃ nāmasahasraṃ me hṛdayaṃ protsukāyatemohena muhyate cetaste sarve baladarpitāḥvighnā dūrāt palāyanta kālarudrādiva prajāḥtamadyāpi gaṇeśānaṃ staumi nāmasahasrakaiḥmahāgaṇapatervakṣye divyaṃ nāmasahasrakamduḥkhāpahaṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ mantranāmasahasrakam)guṇādyo nirguṇo goptā gajavaktro vibhāvasuḥsadāśānto jagattāto [kh: jagattrātā] viśvakseno vibhākaraḥaṇīyān vibhavī śreṣṭho jyeṣṭho gāthāpriyo guruḥpatiḥ pītavibhūṣāṅgo raktākṣo lohitāmbaraḥsurūpaḥ sāttvikaḥ satyaḥ śuddhaḥ śaṅkaranandanaḥdaityamardī madākṣībo madirāruṇalocanaḥparaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sākṣī tryakṣo vikatthanaḥbhṛṅgirīṭī bhṛṅgamālī bhṛṅgakūjitanāditaḥvainateyo vinamrāṅgo viśvanetā vināyakaḥpuṣpadantaḥ puṣpahārī puṣpamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥantyo'ntakaścittagaṇaścittacintāpahārakaḥlipito lohito lupto (100) lohitākṣo vilobhakaḥsundaraḥ sundarīputraḥ samastāsuraghātanaḥvicārī vāntado vāgmī vitarkī vijayeśvaraḥvikartano viyaccārī vinaṭo nartako naṭaḥviśvamūrviśvaghātī ca vinatāsyo vinartakaḥkāruṇyarūpaḥ kuṭilaḥ kulācārī kuleśvaraḥ

sanskrit: rurū ramyamukho rakto revatīdayito rasaḥunmattarūpaḥ kālāgniragnisūryendulocanaḥasitātmā bhairaveśo bhāgyavān bhagavān bhagaḥśubhaṅkaraḥ śuciḥ śāntaḥ śreṣyaḥ śravyaḥ śacīpatiḥvidyāprado vedasāro vaidiko vedapāragaḥ(200) asanmayaḥnirvairo vairividhvaṃsī mattavāraṇasannibhaḥśvaityaḥ śvetaḥ śatamukho mugdho modakabhojanaḥśuddhātmā śuddhamatimāñchuddhadīptiḥ śucivrataḥdārakaḥ śikhivāheṣṭaḥ śītaḥ śaṅkaravallabhaḥlūto līlārasollāsī vilāsī vibhramo bhramaḥbuddho vibudhasevyaśca budharājo balandharaḥjanako jinamārgajño jainamārganivartakaḥparaṃ padaṃ paraṃ dhāma paramātmā kaviḥ kujaḥgrahendro grāhito grāhyo'graṇīrghurghuranāditaḥvanecaro vanapatirvanavāsaḥ smaropamaḥyaśasvī yajamāneṣṭo vajrabhṛd vajrapañjaraḥmīnadhvajo manohārī yogināṃ yogavardhanaḥtapomayastapomūrtistapanaśca tapodhanaḥdaṇḍī caṇḍāṃśuravyaktaḥ kamaṇḍaludharo'naghaḥbhrāmako jātipūjyaśca jāḍyahā jaḍasūdanaḥhaviṣmān havyavāhākṣo hāṭako hāṭakāṅgadaḥhālāpriyo hṛdāśāntaḥ kāntāhṛdayapoṣaṇaḥkūvaro dhīmayo dhyātā dhyeyo dhīmān dayānidhiḥnirgato naigamī gamyo nirjeyo jaṭilo'jaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāmīkaranibho'nādyo [ṅ: nābhyaḥ] nalināyatalocanaḥpañcabhūtātmakaḥ pañcasāyakaḥ pañcavaktakaḥkaṭhorahṛdayo grīvālaṅkṛto lalitāśayaḥdhruvo drutagatirdharmyo dharmī nākipriyo'nalaḥsāgaraḥ svargatiḥ svakṣaḥ sānandaḥ sādhupūjitaḥsurāpriyo vasupatirvāsavo vasupūjitaḥrājī rājīvanayanaḥ smṛtidaḥ kṛttikāmbaraḥkṛttikāsanagaḥ kolo rohī rahaṇapādukaḥmṛgarājo mṛgaśirā mādhavo madhuradhvaniḥbhrūkṣepadattavibhavo bhrūkarālaḥ punarmayaḥtittiristimiketuśca timicārakaghātanaḥmānado mādhavo māgho vācālo maghavopamaḥpūrvaphālgunikaḥ sphītaḥ phalguruttaraphālgunaḥghoṇāhastaścaturhasto hastivaktro halāyudhaḥviśākhaḥ śikhisevyaśca śikhidhvajasahodaraḥanūrādhāpriyo rādhyaḥ śrīmāñchuklaḥ śucismitaḥśuciḥ pūrvastathāṣāḍhaścottarāṣāḍha īśvaraḥśrāvaṇaḥ śravaṇaḥ śrotā dhanī dhanyo dhaniṣṭhakaḥpūrvābhādrapado bhadraścottarābhādrapāditaḥaśviyuk kārtikeyeṣṭo mārgaśīrṣo mṛgottamaḥrājyado'bhijidātmīyastāreśaḥ tārakadyutiḥparahā pañcabhūḥ pañcavāyuḥ pūjyaḥ paraṃ mahaḥgrāho meṣo vṛṣo mando manmatho mithunārcitaḥkukkuṭo vanajo haṃsaḥ parahaṃsaḥ śṛgālakaḥputrado narakatrātā kanyāprītaḥ kulodvahaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: alicāpadharo dhanvī kacchapo makaro maṇiḥvasumūrtidharo vyagro'surahārī yamāntakaḥaṅgadī kuṇḍalī bhaktipriyo bhaktavivardhanaḥkātyāyanīsuto brahmapūjito vighnanāśanaḥvighnāntako mahāgrīvo bhṛśaṃ modakamoditaḥguhāśrayo viṣṇupadītanayaḥ sthānado dhruvaḥcaturdaśīpriyo mānyo vyavasāyo madānvitaḥdhīraḥ śaktimatāṃ śreṣṭho mahābalasamanvitaḥkaraṇaṃ mṛtyuhārī ca pāpasaṅghanivartakaḥbhūtacārī pretacārī buddhirūpo manomayaḥtanmātrarūpo bhūtātmā indriyātmā vaśīkaraḥnīrūpo bahurūpaśca kinnaro nāgavikramaḥviśvakartā viśvabījaṃ (700) śrīḥ saṃpadhrīrdhṛtirmatiḥsaṃhartā sṛṣṭikartā ca sthitikartā layāśritaḥṛgīkṣaṇaḥ kāvyakartā śikṣākārī niruktavitvicāravāñśaṅkhadhārī satyavrataparāyaṇaḥsarvasaṃpatkaro vyāpī meghagambhīranādabhṛtśambhubhaktirato mokṣadātā bhavadavānalaḥprāṇado jñānamūrtiśca nādamūrtiyuto'kṣaraḥkūṭasthaścetano rudraḥ kṣetravit puruṣo budhaḥapratarkyavapuḥ skandānujo bhānurmahāprabhaḥyajñagoptā yajñamayo dakṣayajñavināśakṛtekadaṃṣṭraḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgo vikaṭo dhūmravarṇakaḥsuvarṇagarbhaḥ sumukhaḥ śrīkaraḥ sarvasiddhidaḥsvaṅgaḥ svakṣaḥ (800) śatānando lokavillokavigrahaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrṇānandaḥ parānandaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥrāśitārāgrahamayastithirūpo [idaṃ nāmatrayam] jagadvibhuḥtrirūpaśca tṛtīyāgnistrayīrūpastrayītanuḥṣaḍrasāsvādako'jātaḥ ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭikavatsaraḥaṣṭamīnandano'nārto navamībhaktibhāvitaḥekādaśātmā gaṇapo dvādaśīyugacarcitaḥcaturdaśendrasaṃstutyaḥ pūrṇimānandavigrahaḥmaunī madhuravāṅmūlaṃ mūrtimān meghavāhanaḥraudro rudrapriyo rukmo rudraputro'ghatāpanaḥgāndharvakuśalo'kuṇṭho vaikuṇṭho viṣṇusevitaḥmañjulo mārjano matto durgāputro durālasaḥbhāsvanmukuṭamāṇikyaḥ kūjatkiṅkiṇijālakaḥpadmākṣaḥ padmahastaśca (900) padmanābhasamarcitaḥnārado vāraṇo lolaśravaṇaḥ śūrpakaśravāḥilāmaṇḍalasaṃbhrāntakṛtānugrahajīvakaḥbṛhadāsyaravākrāntabhīmabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍakaḥbṛhaddantakṛtātyugraraṇānandarasālasaḥsphuratsindūravadanaḥ sphurattejognilocanaḥcalattoyapravāhāḍhyanadījalakaṇākulaḥbrahmācyutamahārudrapuraḥsarasurārcitaḥgūrjatpañcānanārāvaprāptākāśadharātalaḥpañcāśadvarṇabījāḍhyamantramantritavigrahaḥśaṅkhadhvanisamākrāntapātālādinabhastalaḥkṛtatretāyugollāsabhāsamānajagattrayaḥsudhāsiktavapurvyāptabrahmāṇḍādikaṭāhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: akārākāraprodgītatāranādanināditaḥukārokāraprodgārighoranāgopavītakaḥḷkārayutaḹkāraśaṅkhapūrṇadigantaraḥokāraukāraviśvādikṛtasṛṣṭikramālasaḥkarṇatālakṛtātyuccairvāyuvījitanirjaraḥgarvitāśeṣagandharvagītatatparaśrotrakaḥṅavarṇāmṛtadhārāḍhyaśobhamānaikadantakaḥchatracāmararatnāḍhyamukuṭālaṅkṛtānanaḥjhāṃkārimadhupavrātagānanādanināditaḥṭaṅkārukaphalāsvādavepitāśeṣamūrdhajaḥṇavarṇāmṛtapīyūṣadhārādharasudhādharaḥthakāradhanapaṅktyāḍhyasantoṣitadvijavrajaḥdhanadādimahāyakṣasaṃsevitapadāmbujaḥparavargāpavargādimārgacchedanadakṣakaḥbaddhabhrūyugabhīmograsaṃtarjitasurāsuraḥmadirākalaśasphītakarālaikakarāmbujaḥratnākarasutākāntakāntikīrtivivardhanaḥvaruṇādidigīśānaracitārcanacarcitaḥṣoḍaśasvaritālāpagītagānavicakṣaṇaḥharādibrahmavaikuṇṭhabrahmagītādipāṭhakaḥtārāṅkamantravarṇaikavigrahojjvalavigrahaḥ [kh: tārārṇa]oṃśrīṃvināyako oṃhrīṃvighnādhyakṣo gaṇādhipaḥvedāntagīto vidyārthī śuddhamantraḥ [kh: siddha] ṣaḍakṣaraḥsaptakoṭimahāmantramantritāśeṣavigrahaḥoṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃdevo mahāgaṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ (1000)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ guptaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitamgrahatārāmayaṃ rāśivarṇapaṅktisamanvitamgaṇeśasya ca sarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ tridivaukasāmaṣṭasiddhimayaṃ sādhyaṃ sādhakānāṃ jayapradamaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtimātrataḥlikhedbhūrje ravau devi puṇyaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasrakamyoṣidvāmakare baddhvā puruṣo dakṣiṇe bhujevaśayedapi trailokyaṃ mārayedakhilān ripūnvandhyā putrāṃllabhecchīghraṃ nirdhano dhanamāpnuyātnagnaḥ śaktiyuto devi bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitānya enaṃ [g: idaṃ] paṭhate nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ bhaktipūrvakamraṇe rājabhaye dyūte paṭennāmnāṃ sahasrakamitīdaṃ puṇyasarvasvaṃ mantranāmasahasrakammahāgaṇapatisahasranāmanirūpaṇamekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥstotramaṅgatamaṃ brūhi mūlamantrasya tattvataḥjīvasyāṅge [ṅ: devasyāgre] kalau śīghraṃ jīvanmuktipradāyakamahibhūṣitakaṇṭhamakṣasūtraṃ bhramayantaṃ hṛdaye smare gaṇeśamvaśībhavanti tridive bhūmau samastā nṛpāḥsakalakṣmāpatimūrdhasu sphuraccaraṇābjo bhuvi śobhate ca saḥniścalāurvaśīvadanapadmaṣaṭpado dhīyate'dharaparāgakāmṛtamraṇe ripūnindrasamān vijitya prāpnoti rājyaṃ nṛpacakravartīcarācare vai vicaredvimāne jagatyaśeṣāmaracakravartīgaṇakinnarasiddhasurāsurairnamito labhate gāṇapatyaṃ saḥvadane vasate sadane vasate hṛdi vāk kamalā tava bhaktirapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhajanti te nandanacandanādivṛkṣeṣu līlāṃ surasundarībhiḥvaśameti kinnarasutāpyurvaśī satataṃ suratadakṣārogā aśeṣā vilayaṃ prayānti tamāṃsi sūrye'bhyudite yathāśutryakṣamagnisadṛśaṃ smaranti ye te prayānti tridivaṃ vimānagāḥtāvakapadaṃ devāsurairdurlabhamsa sādhakaḥpañcāṅgaṃ surasundarivinā śiṣyāya no dadyāt sādhakāya vinā tathāanyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt sarvathā dānamācaretstotranirūpaṇaṃ triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥbhairavaṃ candramukuṭaṃ gaṇagandharvasevitambhasmāṅgarāgadhavalaṃ sarpagonasakaṅkaṇamkapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamarudhāriṇamkāmakālāndhakabhayaṅkaramsādhyasiddhapiśācaugha bhairavapraṇataṃ prabhumgaṅgādharaṃ prasannāsyaṃ hasitānanapaṅkajamtvaṃ śivaḥ parameśānastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ prajāpatiḥnirguṇo bhairavādhyakṣaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇamtvaṃ me prāṇādhiko deva krītāsmi tava kiṅkarīadya tadvada tattvaṃ me yadyahaṃ tava vallabhāvismṛtaṃ vada me śīghraṃ vakṣye prāṇādhikāsi mesakalāgamasārajña kaulikānāṃ hitecchayādevadevasya sūryasya sarvatattvottamottamamsarvāgamarahasyaṃ te vakṣye snehena pārvatimantranāmasahasraṃ ca stotraṃ mūlātmakaṃ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athāhaṃ paṭalaṃ vakṣye mūlamantramayaṃ priyeyo devadevo bhagavān bhāskarastejasāṃ nidhiḥsaviteti ca vedeṣu paramātmā jagatpatiḥkālātmā ca paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahmeti gīyatemantroddhāraṃ paraṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhimayaṃ kalaumantroddhāraḥ saviturvarṇitaste gurgākṣaro bhogamokṣaikahetuḥna śaucaniyamo vāpi viparyayabhayaṃ nahisarvārthasādhako devi na deyo yasya kasyacitkiṃ kiṃ na labhate mantrī vāñchitaṃ sūryamudraṇāttarpayet taddaśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥvaṭe'raṇye śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpathesūryoparāgasamaye grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥmantrasyāsya mahādevi ṛṣirbrahmā samīritaḥvyoṣaṃ bījaṃ parā śaktistāraṃ kīlakamīśvarimāyābījena ṣaḍdīrghabhāginā nyāsamācaretkolatrayaṃ paṭhed devi japādau sādhakottamaḥśarattrayaṃ paṭhenmadhye mūlamantrasya sādhakaḥmātṛkāśodhitaṃ mantraṃ kṛtvā pārvati sādhakaḥvedādiḍimbakāntyacchaṃ śaktirmadhye paṭhecchiveiyaṃ śāpaharī vidyā japyā sādhakasattamaiḥsiddhaṃ mantraṃ japed devi yathāśaktyākṣamālayājagadante paṭhed devi śaradvāraṃ ca kaulikaḥgurūpadeśato jñeyaḥ sūryāstramanuruttamaḥtāraṃ vyoṣaṃ ca sūryāya vidmahe tadanantaramtannaḥ śivaśca śaktiśca paramātmā pracodayāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśadhā sādhakairjapyā saṃdhyāsvarcāsu tarpaṇesarvarogāpahaṃ devi bhogamokṣaphalapradamsvarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhajesarvasaṃmohanaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhimayaṃ śiverekhātrayāñcitadharāsadanaṃ ca devi śrīcakrametaduditaṃ saviturvareṇyamyasya śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhetseśāḥ pūjyā bahirdvāre yantrarājasya sādhakaiḥantardvāsthāḥ śive pūjyā vāmāvartena sādhakaiḥvṛttatraye'rcayenmantrī gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥketuṃ vasudale devi vāmāvṛtyārcayet sudhīḥvidyutāṃ sarvatovaktrāṃ grahairvasudale'rcayettvaṣṭāraṃ tapanaṃ dharmaṃ vasukoṇe samarcayetśrībindumaṇḍale devi savitāraṃ samarcayettapinīṃ tāpinīṃ caiva bodhinīṃ caiva rodhinīmetāḥ saṃpūjya vasvaśre kaulikaḥ kulasiddhayevisphurāṃ savitāraṃ ca bindubimbe samarcayetsuvarṇapadmaṃ saṃpūjya ratnāḍhyakalaśaṃ śivelayāṅgametadākhyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitamaṅguṣṭhau vimukhau madhye saṃyojya tarjanīdvayampadmamudreyamākhyātā bimbamudrāṃ śṛṇu priyeūrdhvaṃ karayugaṃ kṛtvā bimbamudreyamīritātathaiva kaulikaḥ kuryādvāmataḥ savyato'ṅgulīḥsarvarogāpahā khyātā darśanīyārcanāvidhausitāsitau ca tarjanyoḥ rāhuketū pralambayoḥāvāhane ca gandhādau naivedye ca visarjane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khaśolkākhyā mahāmudrā (sarvarogāpahāriṇībaddhvā muṣṭiyugaṃ devi parvaṃ parvaṇi yojayetkhaśolkākhyā mahāmudrā) śatruvargavimardinīmahāmudrā mahāgopyā mahāmārtaṇḍavallabhāśatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāphalamavāpnuyātyeṣāṃ sādhanamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavetvaśīkaraṇavidveṣau śāntikī pauṣṭikī kriyāaprakāśyamadātavyaṃ kalau rogāpahaṃ śivesnātvā japenmahādevi sūryāgre sādhako'yutamsarpiṣā stambhanaṃ sadyo vāditaskarapāthasām [kh: vahni]huned daśāṃśamīśāni ghṛtapadmākṣanāgarānravau sāyaṃ japenmūlaṃ nadītīrasthito rahaḥghṛtena dadhnā santarpya māraṇaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhavethuned daśāṃśamambhojaśaṭīghṛtakulatthakaiḥravau brāhme muhūrte tu snātvā tatra japejjaleghṛtamatsyaṇḍakarpūra padmapadmākṣakesarānsūryodaye japedvidyāṃ sādhako'yutasaṃkhyayāviṣeṇa tarpayed devaṃ bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ dviṣāmayutaṃ taddaśāṃśena huned ghṛtayavākaṇāḥativṛṣṭeranāvṛṣṭeḥ rājabhītermaheśvarimantrāyutaṃ mahādevi juhuyād ghṛtagopayaḥdaśāṃśaṃ tarpayed dadhnā kṣīreṇa sitayā sudhīḥityeṣa paṭalo guhyaḥ savituścātivallabhaḥpaṭalaḥpaddhatiṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa pātakī bhavedrogī yadidaṃ śivaśāsanamsarvatattvarahasyāḍhyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ prāṇavallabhedvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥgāyatrīnāyako bhāsvān [k: śreṣṭhaḥ] saviteti pragīyatesarvamantramayaṃ guhyaṃ [k: divyaṃ] mūlavidyārahasyakamnivāraṇam]sarvatejomayaṃ sarvadevadānavapūjitammātṛkāveṣṭitaṃ varma bhairavānananirgatamdhāraṇādasya deveśi brahmā lokapitāmahaḥśaṅkaraḥ sarvalokeśo vāsavo'pi divaspatiḥmantrātmakaṃ para varma savituḥ sāramuttamamsa rājavallabho loke tejasvī vairimardanaḥiha lakṣmīdhanārogya vṛddhirbhavati nānyathākavacasyāsya deveśi mūlavidyāmayasya cagāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥsarvārthasādhane devi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥuṃūṃṛṃṝṃ lalāṭaṃ me hrāṃ raviḥ pātu cinmayaḥoṃauṃaṃaḥ śrutī pātu saḥ sarvajagadīśvaraḥcaṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃ ca nāsāṃ me pāturyāṃ aryamā prabhuḥtaṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃ galaṃ pātu naṃ nārāyaṇavallabhaḥyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ bhujau pātu mūlaṃ sakalanāyakaḥlaṃkṣaḥ kukṣiṃ sadā pātu grahanātho dineśvaraḥaṃāṃiṃīṃ uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ nābhiṃ pātu tamopahaḥkaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃcaṃ chaṃjaṃjhaṃ kaṭiṃ bhānurmamāvatudivākaraḥ]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṅaṃñaṃṇaṃnaṃmaṃ me pātu savitā sakalaṃ vapuḥbudho māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nair-ṛtyām gurureva māmuttare māṃ tamaḥ pāyādaiśānyāṃ māṃ śikhī tathāprabhāte bhāskaraḥ pātu madhyāhne māṃ dineśvaraḥsarvatra sarvadā sūryaḥ pātu māṃ cakranāyakaḥsaṅgrāme ca jvare roge pātu māṃ savitā prabhuḥpāyānmāṃ kulanāyako'pi savitā oṃhrīṃhasauḥ sarvadāmūlavyāptatanuḥ sadāvatu paraṃ haṃsaḥ sahasrāṃśumānsarvadevarahasyaṃ ca mātṛkāmantraveṣṭitam [kh: varṇa]guhyaṃ yaśaskaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ śiveaṣṭagandhena divyena sudhākṣīreṇa pārvatikanakīkāṣṭhalekhanyā kavacaṃ bhāskarodayesauvarṇenātha saṃveṣṭya dhārayenmūrdhni vā bhujerājamānyo bhavennityaṃ sarvatejomayo bhavetśiraḥsthā guṭikā divyā rājalokavaśaṅkarīvandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganāyasya dehe bhavennityaṃ guṭikaiṣā maheśvaritaddehaṃ prāpya vyarthāni bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥtasya sadyo mahādevi savitā varado bhavettasya pūjārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ janmakoṭiṣu niṣphalammahākuṣṭhārdito devi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥlakṣmīvāñjāyate devi sadyaḥ sūryaprasādataḥmuktimāpnuyāttrayastriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥtvaṃ me prāṇapriyā prītā varado'haṃ tava sthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhagavan devadeveśa mahārudra maheśvaradevadevasya saviturvada nāmasahasrakamrahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ durlabhaṃ kāmanāvahamkarmasākṣī jagaccakṣuḥ stotuṃ taṃ kena śakyatetasyādidevadevasya saviturjagadīśituḥtantravedāgamoddhṛtamsarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanamvakṣyāmi paramaṃ tattvaṃ mūlavidyātmakaṃ parammantrāṇāmapi yat tattvaṃ mahasāmapi yanmahaḥyogināmapi yo yogī vedānāṃ praṇavaśca yaḥtārāṇāmapi yo rājā vāyūnāṃ ca prabhañjanaḥnagānāmapi yo meruḥ pannagānāṃ ca vāsukiḥsavitā yastu gāyatryāḥ paramātmeti kīrtyatesarvadāridryaśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanamjvararogāpamṛtyughnaṃ sadā sarvābhayapradamrājaprasādavijaya lakṣmīvibhavakāraṇammohanastambhanākṛṣṭi vaśīkaraṇakāraṇamśṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā sūryanāmasahasrakamsūryaṃ svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhajesaptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastamādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabjebhagavān sarvalokeśo bhūteśo bhūtabhāvanaḥādityo varado vīro vīralo viśvadīpanaḥviśvātmā puruṣaḥ sākṣī [ṅ: sākṣāt] paraṃ brahma parāt paraḥmanuravyayaḥbhūtabhavyabhaviṣyātmā tattvātmā jñānavān guṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrakiraṇo bhāsvān bhārgavo bhṛgurīśvaraḥtapasvī kālakṛt kālaḥ kamanīyatanuḥ kṛśaḥdvibhujo'ṣṭabhujo dhīro daśabāhurdaśātigaḥjaṭilo nirbhayo bhānuḥ padmahastaḥ kuśīrakaḥmārtaṇḍo kokadhṛt trātā rudro bhadrapradaḥ prabhuḥparākramaḥ]niyatātmā ca kāleśo dineśo bhaktavatsalaḥvyomacārī mahān satyaḥ śambhurambhojavallabhaḥtrijaṭo raktavāhaśca raktavastro ratipriyaḥgambhīraghoṣo nirghoṣo ghaṭahasto mahomayaḥ [k mayomayaḥ]sahasrahasto vijayo harigāmī harīśvaraḥhaimo hemakaro [g: haimakarī] hārī haridratnāsanasthitaḥvirocano vilāsī ca virūpākṣo vikartanaḥmatimān ratimān svakṣo viśālākṣo viśāṃpatiḥgaṅgādharo gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇasevyo gaṇeśvaraḥsatyasandhaḥ sahasraguḥmūrtimān (200) dūrdharo'mūrtistuṭirūpo lavātmakaḥcaṣako ghaṭikārūpo muhūrto dinarūpavānayanaṃ yugarūpaśca kṛtaṃ tretāyugastripātmanvantarātmako devaḥ śakrastribhuvaneśvaraḥ [k: śaktiḥ]jalajāsanaḥkalpāntakalanaḥ krūraḥ kālāgniḥ kālasūdanaḥkālāvarto [gh: kalā] yugadharo yugādiḥ śahakeśvaraḥacintyaḥ subalo bālo balākāvallabho varaḥsāṃkhyeśvaro vedagamyo mantreśastantranāyakaḥ

sanskrit: alasastulasīsevyastuṣṭā roganivarhaṇaḥvairāgyado vimānastho ratnakumbhadharāyudhaḥṛgyajuḥsāmarūpaśca tvaṣṭātharvaṇaśākhilaḥ [kh: śālinaḥ]kalpavṛkṣaśca mandāro (300) mandārācalaśobhanaḥsantānakusumacchannaḥ santānaphalado virāṭvarṣākālo varṣapatiḥ śaradambhojavallabhaḥsumatiḥ sugatiḥ sādhurviṣṇuḥ sāmbo'mbikāsutaḥsumeruśikharāvāsī saptapātālagocaraḥsurathaḥ sugatastutyo veṇuvādanatatparaḥāvedanīyo vedākṣo mahādivyavapuḥ surāṭvasurāvartano nityaḥ sarvāmnāyaprabhuḥ sudhīḥtrikoṇanilayaścetyo bindumaṇḍalamadhyagaḥjapākusumasaṅkāśo japapūjāphalapradaḥsarvatattvāśrayo bradhno vīravandyo vibhāvasuḥādirādityalokeśaḥ sarvagāmī (400) kalāśrayaḥvidyādhareśo vidyeśo yakṣeśo rakṣaṇo guruḥapsarovandito'jayyo jetā daityanivarhaṇaḥsiddhasevyaḥ samāmnāyaḥ sādhusevyaḥ saritpatiḥarko'rkakāntaratneśo'nantabāhuralopakaḥakāramātṛkānātho devānāmādirākṛtiḥālokakṛt tathādityo vīrādityaḥ prajādhipaḥindirāpūjitaścendurindralokāśrayastvinaḥ [g, gh: sthitaḥ]unnatāsyo'pyuruvapurunnatādricaro guruḥ [ṅ: guḍaḥ]ukārākārasukhitastathoṣmā nidhirūṣaṇaḥṛṇahartā ṝlihasta ṝṛbhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ

sanskrit: eṇāṅkāmṛtadaścīnapaṭṭabhṛd bahugocaraḥekārabījaramaṇa eaioṣṭhāmṛtākaraḥoaudantālirahito mahito mahatāṃ patiḥaḥsvarūpaḥ (500) svaramayaḥ sarvasvaraparātmakaḥkarmaikavaradaḥ karmasākṣī kalmaṣanāśanaḥkeśārisūdanaḥ]kapālamocakaḥ kāśaḥ kāśmīraghanasārabhṛtkuvāsī kulakauleśaḥ kakārākṣaramaṇḍanaḥkhageśvaraśca khacaraḥ [kh: khecaraśca] khecarīgaṇasevitaḥgantā gītapriyo geyo gayāvāsī gaṇāśrayaḥsudhīḥ]ghaṭākaraḥṅānto ṅeśo ṅakārāṅgaścandrakuṅkumavāsitaḥcāmīkaraprabhaścaṇḍabhānuścaṇḍeśavallabhaḥcalatpatākaścaṇḍādriścīvaraikadharo'caraḥchurikācchinnavigrahaḥjambārirjaṅgiṭo [kh, g: jaṭilaḥ] jaṅgī janalokatamopahaḥjagattrātā jagaddhātā jagaddhyeyo [k, kh: yoniḥ] jagannidhiḥjakārākāramukuṭo jhañjāchannākṛtirjhaṭaḥjhañākṣarāñcitaṣṭaṅkaṣṭiṭṭibhāsanasaṃsthitaḥḍambharo ḍāmarurḍiṇḍī ḍāmarīśo ḍalākṛtiḥṇeśapriyo ṇavarṇeśo ṇakārapadapaṅkajaḥtripureśastrinetreśastrayītanuradhokṣajaḥtandrāhartā tamorūpastapasāṃ phaladāyakaḥcchedanodyanī]
