sanskrit: dvādaśāntaikavasatirdvādaśātmā divaspatiḥdurdhyeyo duṣṭavaṃśaghno dayānātho dayākulaḥdharmabandhurdharmanidhirdharmarājo dhanapradaḥdhūrjaṭīkṣaṇavāsī ca dharmakṣetro dharādhipaḥdharābhṛdvallabho dharmī dhakārākṣarabhūṣaṇaḥnalinīvallabho nunno nāṭyakṛnnāṭyavardhanaḥnamonto namitārātirnaranārāyaṇāśrayaḥnādarūpo [kh: nādapriyaḥ] nādamayo nādabindusvarūpakaḥnākasthito'nekavapurnakārākṣaramātṛkaḥprītipriyaḥ premakaraḥ praṇatārtibhayāpahaḥpūrṇānandamayaḥ pūrṇatejāḥ pūrṇeśvarīśvaraḥparameśavapuḥ prāṃśuḥ pramattaḥ praṇateṣṭadaḥpācanaḥ piculaḥ pluṣṭaḥ pramadājanasaukhyadaḥphalaṃ bhogāpavargasya phalinīśaḥ phalātmakaḥbālo balapriyo bānto biladhvāntaharo [g, gh: hṛtaḥ] balībudho bṛhaspatirvṛkṣo bṛhadaśvo bṛhadgatiḥbhago bhṛgurbhṛgusthāyī bhārgavaḥ kaviśekharaḥmahākālo (800) mahādhyakṣo mahānādo mahāmatiḥmānado mallahā mallo merumandaramandiraḥmodito madirāhāro mārtaṇḍo muṇḍamuṇḍitaḥmadālaso'marastutyo [g: malastutyaḥ] murārivarado manuḥmālyavān medhano māro medhāvī musalāyudhaḥmadano [g: modanī] modakāhāro makārākṣaramātṛkaḥyātriko yajñaphalado yāyī yāmalanāyakaḥyaṣṭidhārī ca yantreśo yonimaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ

sanskrit: yoginīcakramadhyastho yugaleśvarapūjitaḥrāmo ramaṇaśīlaśca ratnabhānū rurupriyaḥratnāṃśumālī ratnāḍhyo ratnakaṅkaṇanūpuraḥrohiṇīśāśrayo rakṣākaro rātriñcarāntakaḥlakṣmībhānurlatāvāsī lasatkāntiśca lokabhṛtloṅgeśvaro liṅganādo līlākārī lalambusaḥvāmano vīravīrendro vācālo (900) vākpatipriyaḥvāgbhavo vāliśadhvaṃsī vidyānāyakanāyakaḥśaśī śobhākaraḥ śāntaḥ śāntikṛcchamanapriyaḥśrutigamyaḥ śaradbījamaṇḍitaḥ śiṣṭasevitaḥṣaṭpadasvanasantoṣī ṣaḍāmnāyapravartakaḥsūryabhānuḥ sūrabhānuḥ sūribhānuḥ sukhākaraḥsamastasādhakeśānaḥ samastakulaśekharaḥharitsūryo haridbhānurhavirbhug havyavāhanaḥhrāṃbījasūryo hrīṃsūryo hakārākṣaramātṛkaḥkṣutsūryaḥ kṣāntasūryaśca laṃkṣaḥsūryaḥ sadāśivaḥbhūḥsūryaśca bhuvaḥsūryaḥ svaḥsūryaḥ sūryanāyakaḥrāśisūryo yogasūryo mantrasūryo manūttamaḥrudrasūryo brahmasūryo vīrasūryo varottamaḥitīdaṃ devadeveśi mantranāmasahasrakamsarvasāramayaṃ divyaṃ brahmatejovivardhanamsarvayajñaphalaistulyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradamsarvavrataphalodriktaṃ sarvadharmaphalapradamprabhāvamasya deveśi nāmnāṃ sahasrakasya cayaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhiṃdhyāyed devānāmapi durlabham

sanskrit: yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayedvāpi ṛṇoti niyatendriyaḥdhanavāñjāyate loke putravān rājavallabhaḥravau paṭhenmahādevi sūryaṃ saṃpūjya kaulikaḥsaṃkrāntau yaḥ paṭhed devi trikālaṃ bhaktipūrvakamsaptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe yaḥ paṭhedastaṃgate ravauvyatīpāte paṭhed devi madhyāhne saṃyatendriyaḥcakrārcane paṭhed devi japan mūlaṃ raviṃ smaransarvaśatrūn vijityāśu labhellakṣmīṃ pratāpavānkāntāśrito vītabhayo bhavet sa śivasannibhaḥsavitā sarvalokeśo varadaḥ sahasā bhavetiha lakṣmīṃ sadā bhuktvā paratrāpnoti tatpadamaṣṭagandhena divyena nīlapuṣpaharidrayāvilikhya vidhivanmantrī yantramadhye'rṇaveṣṭitamkanyākartitasūtreṇa veṣṭayedraktalākṣayāsādhayenmantrarājena dhārayenmūrdhni vā bhujekuṣṭharogī ca śūlī ca pramehī kukṣirogavānmucyate sahasā dhṛtvā guṭīmetāṃ sudurlabhāmdhārayedguṭikāmetāṃ vakṣasi smayatarpitāmṛtavatsā bahūn putrān surūpāṃśa cirāyuṣaḥakṣatāṅgo mahārājaḥ sukhī svapuramāviśetguṭikāṃ mohanākarṣastambhanoccāṭanakṣamāmdhanena dhanado devi vibhavena ca śaṃkaraḥgirā bṛhaspatirdevi nayena bhṛgunandanaḥārogyeṇa ghaṭodbhūtiḥ kāntyā pūrṇendusannibhaḥgāmbhīryeṇa tathāmbhodhirdātṛtvena baliḥ svayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kiṃ pralāpena bahunā paṭhedvā dhārayecchivesa bhaved bhāskaraḥ sākṣāt paramānandavigrahaḥidaṃ divyaṃ mahat tattvaṃ sūryanāmasahasrakamabhaktāya kucailāya paraśiṣyāya pārvatigurubhaktivihīnāya nindakāya śivāgamekulīnāya subhaktāya sūryabhaktiratāya casarvamantramayaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivatcatustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥpañcamāṅgamayaṃ tattvaṃ sarvāpattāraṇaṃ dhruvamsarvāmayapraśamanaṃ tejobalavivardhanambhogāpavargadaṃ loke rahasyaṃ mama pārvatigāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥpraṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ devi viśvaṃ digbandhanaṃ tataḥvisphurāliṅgitaṃ dhyātvā stotrametadudīrayetsvarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje[k, kh, g: jīyate] drāk surasadasi sudhāpūritābhiśca vāgbhiḥparāsustava padamgadyādipadyāmṛtavarṣiṇī vāg vaktre vibho tasya karasthitā śrīḥbhagavan dhāmāvyayaṃ yāsyatibhagavan vaśyāḥ sadā saṃpadaḥmajātejasvino māninaḥmanasi sarasijeṣṭaṃ sūryamīśaṃ namāmibhagavantamanantamādyamdhāma savituḥtava snehānmayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit

sanskrit: savituḥ sarvasarvasvaṃ [g: tattva] rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamamnāgnibhītirna dāridryaṃ na rogo nāpyupadravaḥidaṃ tattvaṃ hi tattvānāṃ rahasyaṃ devadurlabhamguhyātiguhyaguhyaṃ ca sūryapañcāṅgamuttamampaṭalaḥkalpadrumavanākīrṇe svarṇapāṣāṇamaṇḍitevasantakusumāmoda gandhavāhaikavāhinidevadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ pārvatīsahitaṃ vibhumpannagābharaṇopetaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitamdevadānavayakṣendra piśācoragasevitamprasannavadanaṃ devaṃ devī dṛṣṭvā maheśvaramuvāca pārvatī devī [k: dīnā] śivaṃ trailokyanāyakamtvaṃ śivaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ satyaḥ saccitsvarūpakaḥudbhūtisthitikṛnnityaṃ layakṛd bhuvaneśvaraḥkiṃ tat paraṃ mahattattvaṃ yajjapasyadya santatamstrīsvabhāvānmahādevi punarmāṃ paripṛcchasietadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ vakṣye guhyaṃ divaukasāmtava snehena vakṣyāmi nacākhyeyaṃ mahātmabhiḥsargasthitikaro loke pralayāntakaro layedaityakinnarayakṣendra manujānalapāthasāmadhyakṣaḥ sāttvikaḥ sarvabhūtātmā parameśvaraḥkavacaṃ tattvabhūtaṃ ca mantranāmasahasrakampaṭhāmyaharniśaṃ śāntaḥ paramānandakāraṇamśrotumicchāmyahaṃ nātha vaktumarhasi sāṃpratamvakṣyāmi parameśasya lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te

sanskrit: mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya tetāraṃ parā ca haritaṃ parā lakṣmīstato'bhidhamnāsya vighno navā doṣo na bhītirna viparyayaḥvarṇalakṣapuraścaryāṃ vināyaṃ cāsti doṣabhākpuraścaraṇahīno'pi na mantraḥ phaladāyakaḥardharātre ca madhyāhne puraścaraṇamācaret [kh: mādiśet]ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācanatataḥ svayaṃ caredbahvīḥ puraścaryā vidhānataḥmārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena bhojanampañcaratneśvarīṃ vidyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya hiatha mantrasya deveśi saṃskāravidhimācaretutkīlayenmanuṃ devi tataḥ sañjīvayet punaḥsiddhaṃ mantraṃ japedante punaḥ saṃpuṭitaṃ caretathotkīlanamācakṣe mantrasyāsya maheśvariviśvānte praṇavo devi sakṛduccārayet sudhīḥmantrasañjīvanaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārvati sādaramsañjīvanākhyo gadito mantrarājo maheśvarivakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ guhyāṃ sarvārthadāyinīmmocaya dvayamuddhṛtya parā mā ṭhadvayaṃ japetsiddhaṃ mantraṃ japenmantrī punaḥ saṃpuṭitaṃ caretviśvamādau manuṃ paścānnāma cānte japet priyemantrasyāsya mahādevi varṇito'tra ṛṣiḥ śivaḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇo devi bījaṃ lakṣmīrudāhṛtābhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥyenaiva dhyānamātreṇa lakṣmīḥ sannidhimeṣyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmyāśritaṃ caturbāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyanaṃ bhajenyāsaṃ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgādi karaśuddhyādipūrvakamsarvasaṃmohanaṃ yantraṃ vāñchitaikapradāyakamṣoḍaśāraṃ ravṛttaṃ ca bhūgṛheṇopaśobhitamlayāṅgaṃ devi vakṣyāmi bhogamokṣaphalapradamvajraśaktidaṇḍakhaḍga pāśayaṣṭidhvajāstataḥindrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥkeśavaṃ mādhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindaṃ madhusūdanampadmāyudhaṃ kaiṭabhāriṃ ghoradaṃṣṭraṃ janārdanamṣoḍaśāreṣu deveśi vāmāvartena sādhakaḥasitāṅgaṃ haṃsaketuṃ vaṃśīpāṇiṃ ca pūjayetsaṃhāraṃ rurukaṃ caṇḍaṃ bhūteśaṃ kālabhairavampūjayet sādhakaḥ siddhyai vasupatre maheśvarinṛsiṃhaṃ ca mahādevi devaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathālakṣmīśabdāṅkitaṃ devi vasukoṇeṣu pūjayetpūjayedagravahnīśakramayogena pārvatimahālakṣmīṃ rājyalakṣmīṃ siddhalakṣmīṃ ca pūjayetgandhākṣataprasūnādi gurumālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥtarpayet sādhako devaṃ makāraiḥ pañcabhiḥ paramvakṣye yena bhavet siddhirmantrasyāsya viśeṣataḥvaśīkāraṃ tathoccāṭaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tataḥeṣāṃ sādhanamātreṇa mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatejapedayutamīśāni hunet tatra daśāṃśataḥstambhanaṃ jāyate sadyo vādivātārkapāthasāmdiśo baddhvāsanaṃ śodhya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghṛtanāgarapunnāga karañjakusumāni catadbhasmanā cared bhāle tilakaṃ sādhakottamaḥbhaume gatvā śmaśānaṃ ca japedayutasaṃkhyayādūrvāpatraṃ sāsavaṃ ca mṛtyuśca mriyate kṣaṇātayutaṃ mūlamantraṃ ca hunet sarpiryavākaṇānrambhāpi puratastasya sadyaḥ prādurbhaviṣyatihunedājyena madhunā śaṭīcandrakarīrakānśukre'śokataruṃ gatvā japedayutasaṃkhyayātarpayedāsavājyekṣu rasairbhuktvā daśāṃśataḥśanau gatvā nadītīraṃ japedayutasaṃkhyayāsāraṇālairjambuphalaiḥ śāntikaṃ jāyate kṣaṇātjapedayutamīśāni hunedājyena paṅkajaiḥetadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava bhaktyā mayoditamadātavyamabhaktebhyo duṣṭebhyo vīravanditeānandakāraṇaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivatṣaṭtriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥpaddhatiṃ nityapūjāyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya tesaptatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥkavacaṃ mantragarbhaṃ ca vajrapañjarakākhyayārahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sādhakānāṃ viśeṣataḥyasya dhāraṇamātreṇa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥsūryastejonidhirdevi candramāstārakeśvaraḥkubero'pi dhanādhyakṣo dharmarājo yamaḥ smṛtaḥjaghāna rāvaṇādīṃśca kiṃ vakṣye'hamataḥ paramtriṣṭup chando devatā ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇo mataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyoga iti smṛtaḥlakṣmyā śritaṃ caturbāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhajehrīṃlalāṭaṃ sadā pātu lakṣmīviṣṇuḥ samantataḥhrīṃ nāsāṃ sarvadā pātu lakṣmīdāmodaraḥ prabhuḥlakṣmī kaṇṭhaṃ sadā pātu devī lakṣmījanārdanaḥnamaḥ pārśvau sadā pātu lakṣmīnandaikanandanaḥuṃūṃṛṃṝṃ pātu kukṣiṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīgaruḍadhvajaḥoṃauṃaṃaḥ pātu nābhiṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīviṣṭaraśravaḥcaṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃ pātu śiśnaṃ lakṣmī lakṣmīśvaraḥ prabhuḥtaṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃ pātu corū namo lakṣmījagatpatiḥyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ pātu jaṅghe hasauḥ lakṣmīgadādharaḥlaṃkṣaḥ pādau sadā pātu mūlaṃ lakṣmīsahasrapātindro māṃ pūrvataḥ pātu vahnirvahnau sadāvatuvaruṇaḥ paścime'vyānmāṃ vāyavye'vatu māṃ marutvajraśaktidaṇḍakhaḍga pāśayaṣṭidhvajāṅkitāḥanantaḥ pātvadho nityamūrdhve brahmāvatācca māmprabhāte pātu māṃ viṣṇurmadhyāhne vāsudevakaḥsaṅkarṣaṇo'rdharātre'vyāt prabhāte'vyāt trivikramaḥoṃhrīṃhasauḥ hrīṃśrīṃmūlaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇo'vatuśrīṃśrīṃśrīṃśaśaśālalaṃ pratidinaṃ lakṣmīdhavaḥ pātu māmlakṣmīnārāyaṇasyeṣṭaṃ caturvargaphalapradamlakṣmīsaṃvananaṃ tattvaṃ paramārtharasāyanamdaśavāraṃ paṭhedrātrau ratānte vaiṣṇavottamaḥtrisaṇdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ kavacaṃ manmukhoditammahācīnapadastho'pi yaḥ paṭhedātmacintakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhāṣṭakena vilikhedravau bhūrje japanmanumdhārayedguṭikāṃ mūrdhni lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ smaranvandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganāgurūpadeśato dhṛtvā guruṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japanbahunoktena kiṃ devi kavacasyāsya pārvatisarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ tattvāt tattvaṃ parāt paramdikṣitāya kulīnāya svaśiṣyāya mahātmanevajrapañjarakaṃ varma gopanīyaṃ svayonivatlakṣmīnārāyaṇakavacanirūpaṇamaṣṭātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥbhogadāṃ mokṣadāṃ loke lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya tebhogāpavargadaṃ divyaṃ vada nāmasahasrakamsarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvadevaikavanditamlakṣmīnārāyaṇasyeṣṭaṃ sarvasvaṃ tattvato mamalakṣmīsaṃvananaṃ [kh: saṃvardhanaṃ] loke paratra paramārthadamupapātakapāpānāṃ śamanaṃ damakārakamsarvadevastutaṃ sādhyaṃ caturvargaphalapradamgurūpadeśato devi sarvasiddhimavāpnuyātviśvambharo viśvanātho viśvasūrviśvasūdanaḥapāravibhavo bhavyo bhavabhūtimayo bhavaḥlakṣmīdharādharo lakṣmīdhārādharasamadyutiḥvidyādharapriyo vidyāvādī vidyāviśāradaḥbhāgyavān bhogado bārgo bhṛgubhāvavivardhanaḥlakṣmīvīreśvaro lakṣmīdhanyo lakṣmīvibhākaraḥyāminīśapriyakaro rāhudhvaṃsī viṣāpahaḥhārakaṅkaṇabhūṣāḍhyo maulimān nūpurāñcitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāṇurūpaścaragatiścāruvaktro jayī nayīlakṣmīnetravaśī lakṣmīhāsavaśyo vinartakaḥvāsavo gopyamārgeṣṭo vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥsatyaḥ stutyaḥ śucirnityo nityātmā nityadarśanaḥpañcamasvarasaṅgītaḥ kīrtido mohanāśanaḥlakṣmīyogīśvaro [kh: yogeśvaraḥ] lakṣmīyogado bhogināyakaḥacintyamahimā(100)'cintyagarimā ghoranisvanaḥkāmadevo vaidyavaidyo [ṅ: viśvavaidyo] vedavid vedanāyakaḥyājñiko yamināṃ trātā trilokajanako'jaraḥlakṣmīpṛthurvasuprīto lakṣmīśrīdaḥ śriyaḥpatiḥanirvartī ca niḥsaṅgo nirbhayo nirupadravaḥnirāśrayo nirguṇaśca guṇātīto gaṇeśvaraḥmahākraturyajñavapurvarāho yajñanāyakaḥlakṣmīnirañjano lakṣmīsiddhidaḥ siddhivardhanaḥsarvalokadharo dānto dantidantāyudho damīmahākarmā mahācīno makāraśivapūjitaḥmāṃsāhārī nityasaṅgī mīnāsavarasākulaḥaghoradevo daityārirjitadevo divākaraḥsatsvarūpo virūpākṣo vibhākaraśataprabhaḥpīnabāhuḥ sthūlapādo dīrghacakṣuralaṃbhujaḥlakṣmīsanātano lakṣmīdharmādhyakṣo dhaneśvaraḥvīrahaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ padmanābho jagatprabhuḥsahasrabāhuḥ kṣatreśo brāhmaṇo vaṇijāṃ patiḥcakrārcito nakrapatirvaruṇaḥ śakrasodaraḥamānī mānado mānyo mānavendro manūttamaḥ

sanskrit: śokahā durgamo dṛpto balihā kalināśanaḥatithistithināthaśca nakṣatrapariveṣagaḥpralayāntakaraḥ prājyo jananījanakapriyaḥakrūravaradaḥ krūraḥ kīravāg gaṇanāyakaḥmāntriko mañjulo mantrī māntrikeṣṭavarapradaḥarjitaḥ sukhitastārastārtīyaḥ kārtavīryakaḥlakṣmīgovardhanadharo lakṣmīkambudharo virāṭanukūlo'nukūṭaśca sānumān somasundaraḥarciṣmān vikalaḥ kulyakalpaḥ sajjanapoṣakaḥ [ṅ: pūjakaḥ]vālmīkivarado vandī vandyo bandhūkasannibhaḥbhṛgurbhāsvadvapurbhoktā kartā hartā śatakratuḥlakṣmīkeyūravāṁllakṣmīmaṇidāmavirājitaḥlakṣmīgodhāṅgulitrāṇo lakṣmīsauvarṇakaṅkaṇaḥkakārādikṣakārāntavidyābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥvarṇamānyo mahāvidyāmātṛkākṣaratattvavānkalāvān kīrtimān kūtaḥ kumbhāṇḍaprāṇahārakaḥkrītaḥ kubjaḥ kambudharaḥ kalakaṇṭhaḥ kulālakaḥkarañjakaḥ kartarīśaḥ kanakaḥ kartarīkaraḥkapilaḥ kalaśī kolaḥ kālikaḥ kulamānasaḥlakṣmīkāśīśvaro lakṣmīnavanāthavināyakaḥkhaparaḥ khecaraḥ kheṭaḥ khagagāmī khalāntakaḥkhagāyudhaḥ khaṇḍadhārī khañjanekṣaṇabhañjanaḥkhaṃkhaṭolaḥ khagagatiḥ khecareśvarasevitaḥ [k: pūjitaḥ]khavarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ (400)khāśmarīpriyaḥ]

sanskrit: lakṣmībhūtiprado lakṣmījyotiṣmān gākṣarāñcitaḥgaṅgādharapriyo goṣṭhī gopālo gandhavardhanaḥ'gamaḥ]gurubhaktipriyo golo gaṇḍaśailanivāsakaḥniraṅgo gajavaktreśo gaṇanāyakanāyakaḥgarbhahīno garbhavāhī guṇeyo guṇasāgaraḥlakṣmīpriyaḥ priyaḥ prīto lakṣmīgaruḍavāhanaḥlakṣmīsantānakaḥ sāro lakṣmīsāro latāpatiḥghṛṇī ghṛṇimayo ghṛṣṭo ghusṛṇārakta īśvaraḥvarottamaḥṅoṇarūpavānlakṣmīsevyo nirguṇātmā lakṣmīśānaḥ śivārcitaḥcārunetraścārumukhaścārubāhuścaturbhujaḥcitāvāsī caro'celaścīnāmbaradharo'cyutaḥcandraścandrakalānāthaścārupādaścaturgatiḥcatuḥsamudraśayanaḥ catussāgaralaṅghanaḥcaturvedamayo vaidyaścārvaṅgaścārubhāṣaṇaḥcalaccandrakaśobhāḍhyaścalannūpurakūjitaḥcaladambhodavadanaścaladambhodaśobhitaḥcalatkanakaśṛṅgābhaścalatkanakaśekharaḥlakṣmīśānto mahādakṣo lakṣmīpītāmbaraḥ paviḥchannacchedī chinnamukhaḥ chakārākṣararūpavānjagannātho jagadbhartā jagatkartā jagatsthitiḥjagatsvāmī jagaddhātā jagatsaṃhārakārakaḥjagadguṇī jagatstutyo jagadānandadāyakaḥ

sanskrit: narmadātīrakrīḍākṛnnalinīpatilocanaḥnārāyaṇo niṣkalaṅko navarṇākṛtirātmavānpuṣpapriyaḥ puṣpaśayyāśayānaḥ puṣpaśekharaḥpūjyaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥpārāvārasutābhartā parameśaḥ paraṃ mahaḥpurāṇapuruṣaḥ pīnaḥ pīnavakṣā jitendriyaḥpatrago viśrutaḥ pānthaḥ pathikaḥ pānthatoṣadaḥlakṣmīpītāmbaro lakṣmīpīto lakṣmīparaḥ paramphaṇiśayyāśayānaśca phakārāmṛtamaṇḍanaḥ (800)lakṣmībandhurmahālakṣmībāndhavo lakṣaṇānvitaḥbhānidhirbhagavān bhīto bhītihā'bhayadāyakaḥmaheśvaro mahāmānyo mahāmātyo manoramaḥmahotsāhī mādhavaśca māyādhārī manonmanaḥmadirāmodamudito māramohavivarjitaḥyaśodānandano yānto yaśasvī yodhasainikaḥyogendro yāgapūjyaśca yādavo yādaveśvaraḥyajvā yajño yaśojāto yakārākṣararūpavānrājā ramāpatirdevo rāmo rājā rajorajaḥrevatīramaṇo rākāpatiḥ sarvakalādharaḥlākṣāruṇo lītarākṣo lalajjihvo latāpatiḥlakṣmīlīno'livarṇaśca lakārākāra īśvaraḥviṣṇurvasundharānātho vasudo vasudhādhipaḥvidvān viśālanayano vikāro'vikṛtiḥ pumānvāgmī vānīramūlastho vācāṭo vīranāyakaḥśaṅkaraḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīlaḥ śramī śītāṃśuśītalaḥ

sanskrit: śakraḥ śatrukṣayakaraḥ śatrukālakaraḥ śivaḥṣoḍaśasvararūpaśca ṣoḍaśārṇavibhūṣaṇaḥlakṣmīṣaḍaṅgadhārī ca lakṣmīṣoḍaśavarṇabhṛtsaptasaptiḥ sadācāraḥ sādhuḥ sādhujanapriyaḥsaptadvīpavatīnāthaḥ saptasāgaranāyakaḥsāttvikaḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ samastaduritāpahaḥsamastapātakadhvaṃsī samastasuravanditaḥharirharo hariharo hāṭakeśo haṭāpahaḥlakṣmīharirhṛṣīkeśo lakṣmīhāradharo'naghaḥkṣaṇakṛt kṣaṇadānāthaḥ kṣamāvān kṣubhitāsuraḥananto'nantapūjyaścāpyādirādityasaṃnnibhaḥ [kh: nandipūjya]ūṣmojjvalo'pi ṛṇahā ṝkārojjvalamātṛkaḥaiśvaryasahitaścoṣṭhastathaunmattasvarārcitaḥoṃhrīṃhasauḥ hrīṃśrīṃdevo lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śivaḥ (1000)akārādikṣakārānta vidyānilayamīśvariaśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājipeyasya koṭayaḥmantranāmasahasrasya kalāṃ nārghanti ṣoḍaśīmsvapne lakṣmīpriyaṃ devaṃ varadaṃ so'pi paśyatiśatavarṣasahasrāṇi pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyātsa bhavet sādhakaḥ śrīmān paratra tridivaṃ vrajetyogināṃ yogadaṃ pūjyaṃ [k: puṇyaṃ] bhogināṃ bhogavardhanamvaiṣṇavānāṃ priyataraṃ muktānāṃ paramārthadamvinā dānaṃ na gṛhṇīyānna dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ vinātava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivatlakṣmīnārāyaṇasahasranāmanirūpaṇamekonacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ

sanskrit: mantrastotraṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya tecaturvedāgamastutyaṃ bhogamokṣaikakāraṇamkaulikānāṃ sadā saṃvidānandarasakāraṇamlakṣmyā śritaṃ caturbhāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhajepurāṇamīśaṃ puruṣaṃ] purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ bhaje vibhumdanujāntakadhāma yāti nūnaṃ paramānandamayo gatasmayaḥsurastrībhiḥ sārdhaṃ suraviṭapivāṭīṣu ramateānandarūpo bhavitā lakṣmīnārāyaṇapriyaḥsa yāti devāsurapūjitāṅghriḥ paraṃ padaṃ sarvasurairalabhyamsa kāminīkāmaraṇapravīṇo bhavedarīṇāmurudarpahārīdharaṇidharendro vijayavānsa vairidāvānalavārivāho bhavet sa gīrbhirgurugarvahārīsāmrājyalakṣmīṃ sa ripūn vijitya labhed bhuvi svargamataḥ parāsuḥkamalāśritamīśvaraṃ niviṣṭaṃ paramānandamayaṃ bhajāmyanantamkamalā vimalāśayasya tasya śrutiśīlasya vaśībhavatyavaśyamtava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nacākhyeyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥvarṇitaṃ gopyamarcāḍhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivatkrītāsmi bhavatānena kathanenāsya śaṅkaramayāptaḥ paramānando dāsyahaṃ te bravīmi kimvedānāloḍya tantrāṃśca devi te kathitaṃ mayārahasyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvasvaṃ mama pārvatideyaṃ śiṣyāya śāntāya gurubhaktiparāya camahācīnapadasthāya vaiṣṇavāya mahātmaneitīdaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ tattvāttattvaṃ parātparamcatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhitekinnarīmadhurālāpa mukharīkṛtadiṅmukhebrahmopendrendracandrārka guruśukrasamanvitamcandrārdhamukuṭopetaṃ śūlakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇamkhaḍgakheṭakahastaṃ ca pāśatomarakāyudhamgadāḍamaruhastaṃ ca śataghnīcakrasaṃyutam [ṅ: śataghni]digambaraṃ viśālākṣaṃ trinetraṃ pañcavaktrakamjapantaṃ prahasantaṃ ca gauryāliṅgitavigrahambaddhapadmāsanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalamgirā madhurayā devaṃ provāca parameśvaramādinātho jagattrātā [ṅ: tāto] dīkṣānāyaka īśvaraḥbhavatā tasya devasya parabrahmasvarūpiṇaḥbhaktyā vakṣyāmi pañcāṅgaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacitstotraṃ pañcāṅgabhūtaṃ ca gopayedyaḥ sa sādhakaḥguhyaṃ paramaguhyaṃ ca goptavyaṃ tu [kh: ca] mumukṣubhiḥdivyaṃ sukhakaraṃ sādhyaṃ siddhaṃ vakṣyāmi siddhayedīkṣānāyakavallabho manurayaṃ trailokyacintāmaniḥna kāyakleśadaurbalyaṃ nācāraniyamabhramaḥkevalaṃ paramānandavardhano ripumardanaḥvinā puraskriyāmeṣa mantrarājo na sidhyatiguruhastena yaḥ kuryānmantrasyāsya puraskriyāmvarṇalakṣaṃ puraścaryāṃ tadardhaṃ vā maheśvarijapād daśāṃśato homastaddaśāṃśena tarpaṇamevaṃ vidhāya mantrasya puraścaryāṃ ca sādhakaḥtato japo bhaved devi sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yantroddhāravidhiṃ vakṣye devadevasya pārvatibindutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇa vṛttāṣṭadalamaṇḍitamlayāṅgamasya vakṣyāmi yantrarājasya pārvatiindrādyā daśa dikpālāḥ sāyudhā bhūgṛhe śiveasitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍakrodheśonmattabhairavāḥpūjanīyā vasudale sādhakaistu mumukṣubhiḥsadyojātaṃ vāmadevaṃ pūjayet kāmayoniṣutrikoṇe pūjayed devi svāgreśānāgnibhāgataḥamṛteśvaramīśānamīśvaraṃ bhuvaneśvarammuktākṣasūtraṃ devāṅge pūjayet sādhakottamaḥdhūpadīpādinaivedyaistāmbūlaiśchatracāmaraiḥsarvasiddhipradaṃ devi gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥsakahola ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā tathābījaṃ ca praṇavo devi śaktirhṛjjākhyabījakamcaturvargeṣu vidyāyā viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥkarayorhṛdayādīnāmaṅgānāṃ sādhakottamaḥtattvatrayeṇācamanamātmavidyāśivādināyenaiva dhyānamātreṇa mantrī śaivaṃ padaṃ vrajetkāntyā viśvavimohanaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhāvayettatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi [ṅ: prāpnoti] jīvatirudrabhālasthamīśāni gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥyān vidhāya śive mantrī bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥvaśīkāraṃ tathoccāṭaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathāyena sādhanamātreṇa sarvasiddhirbhavet kalausaṃkalpapūrvaṃ mantraṃ ca japedayutasaṃkhyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stambhanaṃ jāyate vādimukhadasyuvivasvatāmhomo ghṛtayavālājaśākapatrairdaśāṃśataḥmaṅgale sādhakaḥ snātvā gatvā śmaśānamaṇḍalamśrīparṇīmadhukonmiśraiḥ śrīphalaiściñcinīphalaiḥbudhe snātvārcayed devaṃ śrīcakrāgre japenmanumtrikaṇṭakaṃ bilvakaṃ ca strīṇāmākarṣaṇaṃ bhavethomo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapadmākṣacandanaiḥripū rājā dhanī vīro jiṣṇurdāsatvameṣyaticitāgre mūlavidyāṃ tu taddaśāṃśaṃ huned ghṛtamśanau snātvā caret pūjāṃ japedvidyāṃ tathāyutamdhattūrapuṣpasahitān sarvaśāntiḥ prajāyatehomo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapāyasapaṅkajaiḥrogiṇāṃ tathāadātavyamabhaktebhyo gopanīyaṃ svayonivatekacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥgadyapadyamayīṃ divyāṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradāmtasya pūjā tu viphalā śaucahīnā yathā kriyāśrīmahāmṛtyuñjayapūjāpaddhatinirūpaṇaṃ dvācatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥmahāmṛtyuñjayasyāsya na deyaṃ paramādbhutamtrailokyādhipatirbhūtvā sukhito'smi maheśvaritathāpi [gh: tvayāpi] paramaṃ tattvaṃ na dātavyaṃ durātmanetatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi jīvatioṃśrīṃ śivo lalāṭaṃ me oṃhauṃ bhruvau sadāśivaḥtrilocano'vatād gaṇḍau nāsāṃ me tripurāntakaḥhanuṃ me hāṭakeśāno mukhaṃ vaṭukabhairavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: skandhau skandapitā pātu hastau me giriśo'vatustanau tārāpatiḥ pātu vakṣaḥ paśupatirmamaśarvaḥ pātu tathā [kh: mama] nābhiṃ śūlī pṛṣṭhaṃ mamāvatukaṭiṃ kālāntakaḥ pāyādṛrū me'ndhakaghātakaḥgulphau pāyājjaṭādhārī pādau mṛtyuñjayo'vatuśirasaḥ pādaparyantaṃ sadyojāto mamāvatupūrve balavikaraṇo dakṣiṇe kālaśāsanaḥaiśānyāmīśvaraḥ pāyādāgneyyāmagnilocanaḥūrdhve balapramathanaḥ pātāle parameśvaraḥraṇe rājakule dyūte viṣame prāṇasaṃśayeprabhāte pātu māṃ brahmā madhyāhne bhairavo'vatuardharātre mahādevo niśānte māṃ mahomayaḥ [ṅ: manonmanaḥ]itīdaṃ kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhampuṇyaṃ puṇyapradaṃ divyaṃ devadevādhidaivatamtasya haste mahādevi tryambakasyāṣṭa siddhayaḥjayaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ devi saṃprāpsyati sukhī punaḥdurbhikṣe śatrusaṃhāre paṭhet kavacamādarātdhanaṃ putrān sukhaṃ lakṣmīmārogyaṃ sarvasaṃpadaḥgopyaṃ siddhipradaṃ guhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivattrayaścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥmahāmṛtyuñjayasyāsya sārāt sārottamottamammānī manoramāṅgaśca manasvī mānavardhanaḥmaheśvaro mahāmānyo mantrī mantrijanapriyaḥmātaṅgako mattacitto mattacinmattabhāvanaḥjitendriyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ḍāmareśo virūpākṣo viśvabhoktā vibhāvasuḥvinetā vinayī vādī vāntado vāgbhavo [kh: vākprado] vaṭuḥvirādheyo virāgīno vilāsī lāsyalālasaḥdhanī dhyeyo'pyadhyeyaśca dharmyo dharmamayo dayaḥḍulicakṣurdarīvāso dambhī devamayātmakaḥśanaiścaro vegagati(100)rvācālo rāhuravyayaḥbhargarūpabhṛtgajānanapriyo gīto gānī snānārcanapriyaḥparātmako virāḍvāso [ṅ: virāḍdhaumyaḥ] vānaro'mitakarmakṛtnandīśvaro nayo nāgo nāgālaṅkāramaṇḍitaḥtrilocanastrilokeśastrimūrtistripurāntakaḥvyasanī toṣitaḥ śambhustridhārūpastrivarṇabhāktridhāguṇī viśvakartā viśvabhartā''dhipūruṣaḥvivekākṣo viśālākṣo'vidhirvidhiranuttamaḥsmṛtimān smṛtidaḥ smārto brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥcalācalo'calagatirvegī vīrādhipo varaḥsarvavyāpī sarvarūpaḥ sāgaraśca sameśvaraḥ (200)sarasvān satyavāk satyaḥ satyarūpaḥ sudhīḥ sukhīvasumān vasudhānātho vasurūpo vasupradaḥīśo'vaśeṣo'vayavī śeṣaśāyī śriyaḥ patiḥsthiraḥ sthāṇuraṇuḥ pīnaḥ pīnavakṣāḥ parātparaḥpaśurūpaḥ paśupatiḥ paśujñānī payonidhiḥśūlī śubhaṅkaraḥ śobhyaḥ śubhakartā śacīpatiḥcaturbhujaścāṣṭabhujaḥ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitaḥdevo mahodadhirdivyo divyakīrtirdivākaraḥ

sanskrit: tapasvī jaṭilastāpī tāpahā tāpavarjitaḥharivāhī mahaujasko nityo nityātmako'nalaḥvidyādharo vimānī ca vaimānikavarapradaḥvāgbhavo vāsavo vāyurvāsanābījamaṇḍitaḥdākṣo daurbhāgyahā daityamardano bhogavardhanaḥbahurūpo bahumatirbahuvitto vicakṣaṇaḥśaradvarṇavibhūṣāḍhyo galadagdho'ghanāśanaḥnaṭano hāṭakeśāno varīyāṃśca vivarṇabhṛtsahasrarūpo samaguḥ sādhūnāmabhayapradaḥsumahā madyapo matto mattamūrtiḥ sumantakaḥrociṣṇurviṣṇuracyutaścūtano nūtano navaḥdharaṇīdharasevyaśca dharādharasutāpatiḥsthāṇukeśo jaṭī grāmyo grāmārāmo ramāpriyaḥavanīśvaraḥ]tīkṣṇacittastrayīrūpastrayīmūrtistrayītanuḥhaviṣmallocano hālāmayo haritarūpabhṛtguṇajño garuḍo gānatatparo vikramī kramīmahātejā mahāmāro mohito mohavallabhaḥbālyo ripuharo hāhī govirgavimato'guṇaḥmālāmayo mādhavaśca vikartano vikatthanaḥhiraṇyaretāḥ subhagaḥ satīnāthaḥ sirāpatiḥādityo ditijeśāno ditiputrakṣayaṅkaraḥsamudro'mitatejāśca khagendro viśikhī śikhīyajñapeyo vājapeyaḥ śatakratuḥ śatānanaḥgāyiṣṭho madhurālāpo madhumattaśca mādhavaḥ

sanskrit: nākīndro janako janyaḥ stambhano rambhanāśanaḥliṅgādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo vedādhyakṣo vicārakaḥcaturo bhavitā bhāvī bhāvado bhavabhītihāmaṅgalo dharaṇīputro dhanyo buddhivivardhanaḥjahnukanyādharaḥ kalpo vatsaro māsarūpadhṛtśuklāmbaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śuklo bhṛgusuto bhagaḥnātho dānto bhikṣurūpī dātṛśreṣṭho viśāṃpatiḥnīrasaḥ sarasaḥ siddho vṛṣaṇī vṛṣaghātanaḥdurmukho durjayo duḥkhī sukhī sukhavilāsadaḥakṣaraṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ balavān balaghātanaḥnārāyaṇo muktakeśo digdevo dharmanāyakaḥtatsaṅgamo nāmakārī cārī smaranisūdanaḥtrapāvān durgatitrātā durgamo durgaghātanaḥ (600)mahābāhurmahorasko mahānandapradāyakaḥmahāmūrdhā mahādanto mahākarṇo mahoragaḥdigvāsā ditijeśāno muṇḍī muṇḍākṣasūtrabhṛtpurāṇapuruṣo'pāraḥ paramātmā mahākaraḥmahāmukho mahājaṅgho maṇḍalī kuṇḍalī naṭaḥlālasaḥ sālasaḥ sālaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca kampitaḥanalaḥ pavanaḥ pāṭhaḥ pīṭhasthaḥ pīṭharūpakaḥmahātūṇīrasaṃyukto devadānavadarpahāyajuḥsāmamukho guhyo yajurvedavicakṣaṇaḥjaṅgamī bhaṅgado bhāṣādakṣo'bhigamadarśanaḥamoghārthaḥ sindhupatiḥ saindhavaḥ sānumadhyagaḥtrikālajñaḥ sugaṇakaḥ puṣkarasthaḥ paropakṛt

sanskrit: dharmī carmāmbaraścārurūpaścāruvibhūṣaṇaḥ [ṅ: viśoṣaṇaḥ]vaśyo vaśyakaro bhasmaśāyī bhasmavilepanaḥgaṇakāryaḥ kulācāraḥ sarvācāraḥ sakhā samaḥaruṇaścaikacintyaśca triśaṅkuḥ śaṅkudhāraṇaḥvaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ kapotasthaḥ tvaṣṭā tuṣṭo ruṣākulaḥpinākī cāṣṭamūrtiśca kṣitimān dhṛtimāṃstathāsūryadevo yajamāna ākāśaḥ parameśvaraḥbhavaḥ śarvastathā rudraḥ paśunāthaśca śaṅkaraḥgirīśaḥ khaṇḍahastaśca mahānugro gaṇeśvaraḥgaṇeśvaro guṇī nandī dharmarājo durantakaḥamṛtaḥ kālarudraśca kālāgniḥ śaśiśekharaḥ (800)duḥsvapnahṛt prasahano guṇinādapratiṣṭhitaḥyajñarūpo yajñamukho yajamāneṣṭadaḥ śuciḥnāgahārī bhasmadhārī bhūtibhūṣitavigrahaḥvṛṣadhvajo vṛṣārūḍho dharmavṛṣavivardhakaḥsahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛtbrahmadaṇḍavinirmātā śataghnīpāśaśaktimāndevāsuravinirmātā devāsuraparāyaṇaḥguhapriyo gaṇasevyaḥ pavitraḥ sarvapāvanaḥvimuktirmuktitejasko bhaktānāṃ paramā gatiḥkailāsagirivāsī ca himavadgirisaṃśrayaḥkapardī kalpakṛd rudraḥ sumanā dharmavatsalaḥnīlakaṇṭho dhanādhyakṣo nāthaḥ pramathanāyakaḥsenākalpo mahākalpo yogo yugakaro hariḥvisargo liṅgarūpaśca pavitraḥ pāpanāśanaḥ (900)

sanskrit: vibudho'gravaraḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvadevastapomayaḥguhaḥ kānto nijasargaḥ pavitraḥ sarvapāvanaḥkālahṛt kevalātmā ca ṛgyajuḥsāmavedavānbrahmādhipatirbrahmapatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatistathāme-asturūpaścārvaṅgo gāyatrīrūpadhāraṇaḥsarvataḥ śarvasarvebhyo namaste rudrarūpebhyaḥmahākālo bhairaveśo veśī kalavikaraṇaḥsarvabhūtādidamano devadevo manonmanaḥbhave bhave nātibhave bhajasva māṃ bhavodbhavaḥparaḥ śivaḥ paro dhyeyaḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ parātparaḥoṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃhsauḥ devo oṃśrīṃhauṃ bhairavottamaḥoṃhrīṃ sadāśivaḥ oṃhrīṃ āpaduddhāraṇo manuḥbhagavāṃstryambaka oṃhrīṃ oṃhrīṃ candrārdhaśekharaḥhrāṃhrīṃhruṃ harivāmāṅga oṃhrīṃhūṃhrīṃ trilocanaḥrudro ghoraravo'ghoro oṃ kṣmyūṃ aghorabhairavaḥoṃ tryambakaṃ jayāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanamsarvasvaṃ nākināṃ devi jantūnāṃ bhuvi kā kathāgopyaṃ sahasranāmedaṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpakammṛtyuñjayasya devasya phalaṃ tasya śive śṛṇutejasā vahnidevastu kavitve caiva bhārgavaḥīśvaratvena deveśi matsamaḥ kimataḥ parampaṭhet sahasranāmedaṃ siddhimāpnoti sādhakaḥśmaśāne prāntare durge pāṭhāt siddhirna saṃśayaḥyatra yatra bhaye prāpte viṣavahnibhayādiṣubhaumāvasyāṃ niśīthe ca gatvā pretālayaṃ sudhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śanau darśadine devi niśāyāṃ saritastaṭesudarśano bhavedāśu mṛtyuñjayaprasādataḥiha loke bhavedrājā pare muktirbhaviṣyatimantragrabhaṃ manumayaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ durātmanerahasyaṃ mama sarvasvaṃ gopyaṃ guptataraṃ kalaudurjanād rakṣaṇīyaṃ ca paṭhanīyamaharniśamcatuścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥmūlamantraikasarvasvaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥvisarjane tathāhvāne sa dīkṣāphalamāpnuyātgāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ mahāmṛtyuñjayaḥ śivebhogāpavargasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥkāntyā viśvavimohanaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhāvayepīyūṣadravavarṣaṇo'pyaharahaḥ prīṇātu mṛtyuñjayaḥdaurbhyāṃ sudhāṃśudyutiminducūḍaṃ namāmi mṛtyuñjayamādidevamsmaredrātrau mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi jīvatitatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi jīvatiyo japet sa bhavedviśvavaibhavāspadamīśvariyo japet tasya vaktrābje narīnartti hi bhāratīcintayan yo bhaveccitte sa śivādvayatāṃ labhetnisargato bhajedyo'ntarlīyate sa pare padekare lakṣmīrmukhe vāṇī tasya śambho raṇe jayaḥsa sārvabhaumasāmrājyaṃ bhajedante salokatāmjapedyaḥ śaradambhodadhavalaṃ tadyaśo bhrametsa kaulikaśiroratna rañjitāṅghriyugo bhavetkaṅkālamālābharaṇo bhavitā bhairavopamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmai dāsyasi bhoḥ śambho nijaṃ dhāma sanātanamśivasāyujyapadavīmbhūgṛhāḍhya iti cakramaṇḍale tvāṃ niṣaṇamuṣasi smarāmyahamniṣaṇamīśānamaśeṣaśeṣavāṇītanuṃ mṛtyuharaṃ namāmisakalasurasevyaḥ śivasamaḥpaṭhedvā pāṭhayennityaṃ sarvasvaṃ devadurlabhammahāmantramayaṃ divyaṃ sādhanairdhanasādhanampaṭhenniśīthe mantrī tu sadyaḥ siddhirbhavet kalaupaṭhitvā kauliko devi bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥyasya kasya na vaktavyamityājñā pārameśvarīpañcacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥyat purā sūcitaṃ deva durgāpañcāṅgamuttamamtadadya kṛpayā brūhi yadyasti mayi te dayādurgāyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ na kasya kathitaṃ mayāguhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ divyaṃ na deyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥdevairārādhitā pūrvaṃ brahmācyutapuraḥsaraiḥsaivaṃ sṛjati bhūtāni rājasī parameśvarīitthaṃ guṇatrayīrūpā sṛṣṭisthitilayātmikātasyāḥ pañcāṅgamadhunā rahasyaṃ tridivaukasāmpaṭalaṃ tava vakṣyāmi durgāyāstattvamuttamamsarvatantreṣvavikhyātaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradamdurgāyāste varṇito mūlavidyāmantroddhāro gopito'ṣṭākṣaro'yamno vā prayāsasaṃyogo nācārayugaviplavaḥaṣṭākṣaro'ṣṭasiddhīśo gopanīyo digambaraiḥmantrarājo mahādevi sadyo bhogāpavargadaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācanapuraścaryāṃ caret paścāt saṃpuṭāḍhyaṃ carenmanumyaṃ japtvā sādhako bhūmau vicaredbhairavo yathāchando'nuṣṭub devatā ca śrīdurgāṣṭākṣarā smṛtātāraṃ kīlakamāśānāṃ viśvaṃ bandhanamīśvaritāramāyākṣarairdevi nyāsaṃ ṣaḍdīrghabhāgibhiḥdurgāṃ navārakulapīṭhagatāṃ bhaje'hamsarvasiddhipradaṃ cakraṃ sarvāśāparipūrakamyantramidaṃ pradiṣṭamyenoccāraṇamātreṇa koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhetcaturdvāreṣu deveśi pūjayet sādhakeśvaraḥmāheśvarī ca kaumārī vārāhī nārasiṃhikāasitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodhonmattakapālikāḥpūjyāḥ pṛthak pṛthag devi gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ śivepūjayet padmakiñjalkaiḥ ṣaḍaśre ṣaṭ kulāmbikāḥcaṇḍaghaṇṭāṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍāṃ skandamātaramīśvaripunaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā śrīcakre paramārthadekālarātrī mahāgaurī devadūtīti pārvatidūrvādalāñjaliṃ dattvā yantrarāje'ṣṭasiddhide [ṅ: siddhaye]tatrāyudhāni deveśi pūjayedaṣṭa sādhakaḥśūlaṃ saṃtarjanīṃ divyāṃ nānāpuṣpaiḥ samarcayetatha vakṣye mahādevi prayogānaṣṭa siddhayestambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇe tataḥeṣāṃ sādhanamācakṣe prayogāṇāṃ maheśvariayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ śmaśāne niśi sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stambhanaṃ jāyate kṣipraṃ vādikāmijanāmbhasāmhomo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapadmākṣapaṅkajaiḥdevānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca kā kathālpadhiyāṃ nṛṇāmvetasīmūlago vāpi hunet tatra daśāṃśataḥayutaṃ prajapedrātrau śūnyāgāre kuleśvarikapibījairapi [k, kh: kāpibījaiḥ] prātarbhavedākarṣaṇaṃ striyāmājyābjakṣurapāṣāṇḍa raktapuṣpāṇi pārvatiayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ sādhako'śvatthamūlagaḥripumuccāṭayet śīghraṃ yadi śakrasamo bhavet[gh: pracchakaḥ]ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ līlopavanamaṇḍalepādairaṣṭabhirīśāni sadyaḥ puṣṭiḥ prajāyatedurgārahasyabhūto'pi gopanīyo mumukṣubhiḥṣaṭcatvāriṃṣaḥ paṭalaḥyasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhetsaptacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥdurgāyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ kavaceśvarasaṃjñakamyogipriyaṃ yogagamyaṃ [kh: yogigamyaṃ] devānāmapi durlabhamdhāraṇādasya deveśi śivastrailokyanāyakaḥbrahmā pārvati lokeśo vighnadhvaṃsī gajānanaḥsūryastamopahaścaiva candro'mṛtanidhistathāmartyo'pyamaratāṃ yāti sādhako mantrasādhakaḥchando'nuṣṭup priye durgā devatāṣṭākṣarā smṛtādharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyoga iti smṛtaḥduṃ netre'ṣṭākṣarā pātu cakrī pātu śrutī mama
source_edition: Muktabodha M00310 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāyurnāsāṃ sadā pātu raktabījanisūdinībhekībījaṃ sadā pātu dantān me raktadantikāoṃaiṃklīṃ pātu me skandhau skandamātā maheśvarīaiṃśrīṃhrīṃ pātu me hastau śivāśataninādinīoṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ pātu kukṣiṃ mama mātaṅginī parāoṃstrīṃhūṃaiṃ pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ mama durgatihāriṇīoṃaiṃklīṃsauḥ sadā pātu kaṭiṃ kātyāyani mamaaiṃsauḥklīṃsauḥ pātu guhyaṃ guhyakeśvarapūjitāoṃjuṃsaḥsauḥ pātu jānū jagadīśvarapūjitāoṃhrīṃśrīṃgīṃ sadā pātu gulphau mama gaṇeśvarīpūrve māṃ pātu brahmāṇī vahnau māṃ vaiṣṇavī tathāpaścime pātu vārāhī vāyavye mā'parājitāūrdhvaṃ durgā sadā pātu pātvadhastācchivā sadāsāyaṃ sarasvatī pātu niśīthe cchinnamastakāagnerambā ca māṃ pātu jalānmāṃ jagadambikāsiṃhāt siṃhāsanā pātu sarpāt sarpāntakāsanāyakṣebhyo yakṣiṇī pātu rakṣobhyo rākṣasāntakāsarvatra sarvadā pātu oṃhrīṃ durgā navākṣarāmantragarbhaṃ maheśāni kavaceśvarasaṃjñakamaṣṭasiddhipradaṃ gopyaṃ parāpararahasyakammahāpātakakoṭighnaṃ mānadaṃ ca yaśaskaramatyantagopyaṃ deveśi kavacaṃ mantrasiddhidamravau bhūrje likhed dhīmān kṛtvā karmāhnikaṃ priyelikhitvā dhārayed bāhau guṭikāṃ puṇyavardhinīmguṭikāṃ dhārayenmūrdhniṃ rājānaṃ vaśamānayet
